astro.tagline: Honest kundli, practical remedies, pooja at home
astro.about: We are a family of Vedic astrologers and pandits on Mandir Road, guiding families, students, shop owners and NRIs for everything from a child's naamkaran to a daughter's kundli milan and a new shop's griha pravesh. Every consultation starts with your exact birth time and ends with a written note of what the chart shows and what to do about it, in simple Hindi or English, without fear and without pressure to buy anything. Vastu visits are done at your home, shop or office with a compass and your floor plan, and every pooja, havan and katha is performed at your place on the correct muhurat with the full samagri list sent in advance. Whatever you share with us, your birth details, your questions and your family matters, stays in this room.

products.name: Detailed Kundli Reading (Janam Patri)
products.desc: Your complete birth chart prepared from the exact date, time and place of birth, with lagna, rashi, nakshatra, current mahadasha and antardasha, and a 45-minute sitting on career, education, marriage, health tendencies and finance.
features: Printed kundli (16 pages, Hindi or English) handed to you
Current dasha and the next 2 – 3 years explained in plain words
Sade Sati, Mangal dosha and Kaal Sarp checked and explained honestly
Written remedies note: mantra, daan, fasting day, gemstone only if truly needed

products.name: Kundli Milan for Marriage (Ashtakoot + Mangal Dosha)
products.desc: Both charts matched on all 36 gunas, with Mangal dosha, Nadi dosha and Bhakoot checked properly and not just the guna score. You get a clear yes, no or 'yes with this upaay', along with the reasoning, so the family can decide with confidence.
features: Ashtakoot 36-guna matching with a printed report for both families
Mangal, Nadi and Bhakoot dosha checked with cancellations (not blindly rejected)
Longevity, temperament and financial compatibility of both charts discussed
Second match of the same person checked at half price

products.name: Phone / Video Consultation (30 min)
products.desc: For one specific question: a job offer, a property deal, a delay in marriage, a child's studies abroad. Send your birth details on WhatsApp, we prepare the chart before the call, and the whole 30 minutes goes into your question.
features: Chart prepared in advance so no time is wasted on the call
Available 7:00 – 21:00, including Sundays, in Hindi or English
Short written summary of the guidance sent after the call
Pay by UPI after the slot is confirmed

products.name: Home Vastu Visit (up to 3 BHK)
products.desc: A visit to your flat or house with a compass and your floor plan: main door, kitchen, bedrooms, mandir, toilets, water tank and the direction you sleep and study in. You get a room-by-room note of simple corrections that do not need any demolition.
features: Direction of every room checked on site with a Vastu compass
Fixes that work in a rented flat too: colours, placement, mirrors, plants, lighting
Correct spot for mandir, safe, study table and the head of the bed
Follow-up on WhatsApp for 30 days after the visit

products.name: Shop / Office / Clinic Vastu
products.desc: For a new or struggling shop, showroom, clinic or office. We check the entrance, cash counter, owner's seat, storage, staff seating and the sign board direction, then suggest what to move and what to keep so the place works for you.
features: Entrance, counter and owner's cabin direction fixed on the plan
Placement of safe, computer, water and stock room suggested
Review of a plot or shop before you sign the agreement: ₹1,100 only
Suitable opening muhurat for the shop included

specs.label: Area
specs.value: Up to 1,500 sq ft; larger on request

products.name: Satyanarayan Katha at Home
products.desc: Full Satyanarayan pooja and katha at your home for a birthday, anniversary, new job, new vehicle or just Purnima. Pandit ji comes with the pooja kit; you arrange the prasad and the family. Done in about two and a half hours with every step explained.
features: Complete katha in five adhyay with sankalp, kalash sthapana and aarti
Samagri list sent on WhatsApp 3 days before; or we bring it for ₹900 extra
Panchamrit, prasad (sheera / panjiri) recipe and quantity guided
Available on Purnima, Ekadashi and other dates; book early for Purnima

products.name: Griha Pravesh Pooja with Havan
products.desc: The complete entry pooja for a new flat or house: muhurat selection, Ganesh pooja, Navgrah pooja, Vastu Shanti havan, kalash and the first boiling of milk in the new kitchen. Two pandits come so that the havan and the mantra path run together and finish in time for your guests.
features: Muhurat fixed as per your family's rashi and the Panchang, free with the booking
Two pandits, havan kund and all pooja vessels brought by us
Samagri list for the family sent 5 days ahead; full kit arranged for ₹1,800 extra
Short Vastu walk-through of the new home on the same day

products.name: Navgrah Shanti Pooja & Havan
products.desc: The nine-planet shanti pooja recommended after a kundli reading shows a difficult dasha, Sade Sati, Mangal or Kaal Sarp yoga, or before a marriage or a big new venture. Performed at your home or at the Shiv Mandir with the full 9-grain, 9-colour and 9-samidha vidhi and jaap of each graha's mantra.
features: Jaap of all nine graha mantras in the prescribed count by three pandits
Havan with the specific samidha wood and offerings for each planet
Daan items listed for the family; we guide what to give and to whom
Can be combined with Rudrabhishek or Mahamrityunjay jaap on request

services.desc: Birth chart prepared from your exact birth details and explained for career, studies, marriage, health tendencies and money, with a written note of guidance.

services.name: Vastu for home, shop & office
services.desc: On-site visit with compass and floor plan, practical corrections without demolition, and a review of a plot or flat before you buy.

services.desc: Satyanarayan katha, griha pravesh, Navgrah shanti, Rudrabhishek, Lakshmi pooja, naamkaran, mundan and shraddh, with samagri list sent in advance.

services.name: Remedies, rudraksha & gemstone guidance
services.desc: Simple traditional upaay: mantra, daan, vrat and, only where the chart calls for it, the right gemstone or rudraksha, with pran-pratishtha done here. Buy the stone from any trusted jeweller; we do not sell.

offer.title: Festival season offer
offer.text: Book Diwali Lakshmi-Ganesh pooja, griha pravesh or any home havan before Dhanteras and get your family's full-year muhurat list (vivah, griha pravesh, vehicle, business, travel) prepared free on WhatsApp.

reviews.name: Sunita D., mother of the bride
reviews.text: We had two rishtas and both charts were matched by Pandit ji in one sitting. He did not just give the guna score; he explained why the first one had a Nadi dosha that was cancelled and the second did not match in Bhakoot. We went ahead with the first and the wedding was fixed on a muhurat he gave. Everything was explained to both families calmly.

reviews.name: Rajesh K., mobile shop owner
reviews.text: My new shop was not picking up for six months. He came with the compass, moved my cash counter from the south-west corner to face north-east, told me to shift the stock room and change the board colour, and gave a fresh opening muhurat. Small changes, no breaking of walls. The written note on WhatsApp was useful to show the carpenter.

reviews.name: Anil & Megha, griha pravesh
reviews.text: Booked the griha pravesh pooja on WhatsApp from Pune while the flat was still being finished. The samagri list came five days before, the two pandits reached at 7 am sharp with the havan kund and finished before the relatives came for lunch. The only thing: Purnima dates get full fast, so book early.

faq.q: What details do I need for a kundli reading?
faq.a: Your date of birth, exact time of birth (from the hospital record or birth certificate if possible) and the place of birth. If the time is not known, tell us; we can do a prashna kundli or birth-time rectification from life events, which takes a little longer.

faq.q: Can I consult on phone or video if I live in another city or abroad?
faq.a: Yes. Send your birth details and question on WhatsApp, we fix a slot between 7:00 and 21:00 IST, prepare your chart in advance and talk on WhatsApp video or Google Meet. The fee is ₹501 for 30 minutes, paid by UPI or bank transfer, and a short written summary is sent after the call.

faq.q: How long does kundli milan take and what do you check?
faq.a: With both birth details, the report is ready the same day. We check all 36 gunas, Mangal dosha with its cancellations, Nadi and Bhakoot dosha, and the strength of both charts for health, temperament and finances. You get a printed report and a 20-minute discussion with the family, and an honest opinion even if it is not what you hoped for.

faq.q: Do you come home for vastu, and can you check a flat before I buy it?
faq.a: Yes, we visit homes, shops, offices and clinics within the city; the home visit is ₹2,100 for up to 3 BHK and ₹3,100 for a commercial place. For a plot or flat you are about to buy, send the floor plan with the north direction marked on WhatsApp for a first opinion, or book a pre-purchase visit at ₹1,100.

faq.q: For a pooja at home, who arranges the samagri and how many pandits come?
faq.a: We send the complete samagri list on WhatsApp 3 – 5 days before so you can buy it locally, or we bring the full kit for a fixed extra charge (₹900 for Satyanarayan, ₹1,800 for griha pravesh, ₹2,500 for Navgrah). One pandit comes for a katha, two for griha pravesh and three for Navgrah shanti; all dakshina is included in the price shown.

faq.q: Will my details and problems stay private? Do you force gemstones or expensive remedies?
faq.a: Everything you share stays between us; we do not discuss one family's chart with another and we do not keep your details on any website. Remedies are mostly mantra, daan and vrat. We suggest a gemstone or rudraksha only where the chart clearly calls for it, we do not sell them, and you are free to buy from any jeweller you trust and bring it to us for pran-pratishtha.

hours.time: Pooja bookings and video consults only

Knows what birth details to collect (date, exact time, place), that an unknown birth time can be handled by rectification, the consultation hours, the ₹1,000 advance to block a pooja muhurat date, UPI payment, travel charges outside the city, the 30-day vastu follow-up, the privacy policy, the current festival-season offer, the address and the hours. For a booking it collects the service wanted, the birth details or the pooja date and venue, the number of people in the family, and shares the fee and the samagri list; for kundli questions it asks for the details and offers the next available slot. It does not give predictions itself and never promises any result from a pooja or remedy.

auto.tagline: Estimate first, genuine parts, old parts returned
auto.about: We are a multi-brand car and two-wheeler garage on the Bypass Road, servicing Maruti, Hyundai, Tata, Mahindra, Honda, Toyota and Kia cars and all popular bikes and scooters for families, taxi owners and small fleets in the city. Every vehicle goes on the OBD scanner and a 25-point check before a single part is touched, and you get the work list and the cost on WhatsApp to approve before we start. We fit only genuine or company-approved parts, give a GST bill for every job, and hand you the old parts in a bag with your keys. Free pickup and drop within 8 km, insurance claim repairs handled from survey to settlement, and a clean waiting area with CCTV on the bays, so you can watch your car being worked on from the sofa or from your phone.

products.name: Basic Car Service (hatchback)
products.desc: The every-6-months service for Alto, WagonR, Swift, i10, Tiago and similar cars: fresh engine oil and filter, all fluids topped up, a 25-point check and a wash before handover.
features: Semi-synthetic engine oil (3.5 L) and oil filter
Air filter and AC filter cleaned, brake pads inspected
Coolant, brake fluid and washer fluid topped up
Exterior wash and interior vacuum included

products.name: Comprehensive Car Service (sedan / SUV)
products.desc: For City, Verna, Creta, Nexon, Scorpio, Innova and similar at the 20,000 or 40,000 km mark: full-synthetic oil, all filters changed, brakes serviced and the car on the lift for an underbody check.
features: Full-synthetic engine oil (up to 5 L), oil and air filter replaced
Brake pads cleaned and greased, discs checked, fuel filter as per schedule
Underbody, suspension bushes and CV boots inspected on the lift
OBD scan report and spark plugs checked; wash and polish included

products.name: Bike & Scooter Full Service
products.desc: Splendor, Activa, Jupiter, Pulsar, Classic 350 and all popular models: oil change, chain and brake adjustment, carburettor or FI check and a wash, done while you wait.
features: Engine oil change (oil charged extra, ₹380 – ₹650 by grade)
Chain cleaned, lubed and tensioned; both brakes adjusted
Clutch and throttle cable play set, tyre pressure and lights checked
Foam wash and polish before handover

features: Vacuum and pressure leak test before any gas goes in
Up to 450 g R134a gas included; R1234yf priced separately
Condenser pressure-washed, blower and vents cleaned
New cabin filter and anti-bacterial duct treatment

products.name: Denting & Painting (per panel)

features: Paint matched by your car's colour code, not by eye
Two-pack (2K) paint with clear coat, oven-baked
Small dents under 2 inches from ₹700 with PDR, no paint
Full-body repaint and bumper plastic welding quoted on request

features: Battery and charging system tested free before you buy

features: 3D camera alignment on all four wheels, printout given
Balancing with stick-on or clip weights for alloy and steel rims
Tyre rotation and nitrogen top-up included
New tyres from MRF, Apollo, CEAT and JK fitted at market rate

products.name: Interior Dry Clean & Exterior Polish
products.desc: The deep clean before Diwali or before you sell the car: seats, roof lining, carpets and boot shampooed and vacuumed, dashboard and vents dressed, and the body machine-polished to take out swirl marks.
features: Seats, floor mats and boot shampoo-extracted, not just wiped
AC vents, dashboard and door pads cleaned and dressed
Machine polish and wax on the body; headlamps de-yellowed
Ceramic coating and PPF quoted separately on request

services.name: Periodic servicing, all brands
services.desc: Service as per your car's own schedule, with the brand's oil grade and genuine filters, without the showroom waiting list or the showroom bill.

services.name: Engine, clutch & electrical diagnosis
services.desc: Check-engine lights, starting trouble, overheating, clutch slip and wiring faults traced on the OBD scanner first, so you pay for the actual fault and not for trial and error.

services.name: Accident repair & insurance claims
services.desc: Cashless and reimbursement claims with all major insurers: we arrange the survey, send the photos and estimate, and you pay only your share when the car is ready.

services.name: Free pickup & drop
services.desc: A driver collects the vehicle from your home or office within 8 km, sends you a photo at the garage, and brings it back washed when the work is done.

services.desc: Buying a second-hand car? We check the engine, gearbox, chassis for accident repair, odometer history and papers for ₹1,499, and tell you plainly whether to buy and at what price.

services.name: Certified used cars & exchange
services.desc: A small stock of inspected, serviced used cars with clear papers and a 3-month workshop warranty; exchange your old car against them or sell it to us outright.

services.desc: MRF, Apollo, CEAT, Exide and Amaron at market rate, plus wipers, bulbs, horns, seat covers, floor mats and dash cams fitted while you wait.

offer.text: Free 25-point check, AC vent cleaning and foam wash with any car service till 10 November; wiper blades and bulbs at 20% off during the camp.

reviews.name: Neha T., working mother
reviews.text: My Swift's AC had been weak for a year and two other garages just topped up gas. These people found a leak at the condenser pipe with the dye, showed it to me on video, fixed it and now it cools properly in city traffic. The estimate came on WhatsApp before they touched anything.

reviews.name: Rakesh, taxi owner
reviews.text: I run three Dzires and cannot afford a car standing idle. They take my cars at 8 in the morning and return them by evening, bill is itemised with every part, and the old parts come back in a bag. The clutch overhaul on one car has done 40,000 km without a complaint.

reviews.name: Dr. Sameer, dentist
reviews.text: After a parking scrape on my Creta they handled the whole insurance claim, including the surveyor visit, and I paid only the depreciation share. The repainted door matches perfectly; I honestly cannot tell which one was done. Took four days as promised.

faq.q: Will servicing outside the showroom void my car's warranty?
faq.a: No. In India the warranty stays valid as long as the service is done on schedule with the recommended oil grade and genuine parts, and we give you a GST bill with the odometer reading and parts list for your record. For cars still under extended warranty or free service, we tell you honestly if the showroom is the better option for that particular visit.

faq.q: How do I know I am not being charged for parts I do not need?
faq.a: Three ways. Before any work, you get a WhatsApp message with the list of jobs, each part's price and labour, and nothing outside that list is done without a fresh approval. Every replaced part is handed back to you in a bag. And the bays are on CCTV, so you can watch live from the waiting area or ask for the link on your phone.

faq.q: Do you give pickup and drop, and is it really free?
faq.a: Yes, free within 8 km of the garage for any service above ₹999; beyond that we charge ₹150 to ₹300 by distance. Message us your location and a time slot; our driver sends you a photo of the odometer and the car when he picks it up and again when he drops it back.

faq.q: How long does a regular service take, and can I wait?
faq.a: A basic car service takes 3 to 4 hours and a bike service 60 to 90 minutes, so you can wait in the AC lounge with Wi-Fi and tea. Comprehensive services, AC work and denting-painting need the car for a day or more; we tell you the exact handover time when you drop it and message you if anything changes.

faq.q: Can you handle my insurance claim for accident repair?
faq.a: Yes, for both cashless and reimbursement claims. Send us photos of the damage and your policy; we raise the claim, arrange the surveyor's inspection at our garage, share the approved estimate with you, and you pay only the deductible and depreciation share when the car is ready. Minor scratches are often cheaper to pay for than to claim, and we tell you that too.

faq.q: Is there a warranty on your work and the parts?
faq.a: Genuine parts carry the manufacturer's warranty, which is on your bill, and batteries and tyres have their brand warranty card registered in your name. On our own workmanship we give 30 days or 1,000 km, whichever is later: if the same complaint comes back in that period, we fix it without labour charge.

ayurveda.tagline: Treating the person, not just the symptom
ayurveda.about: We are an Ayurveda and homeopathy clinic on Station Road, with a BAMS vaidya and a BHMS doctor under one roof. People come to us for acidity and digestion, skin and hair troubles, joint and back pain, PCOS, migraine, and the lifestyle complaints that keep coming back. Every patient gets a proper 30-minute sitting — nadi, tongue, history, sleep and daily routine — before a single medicine is written, and the plan always carries a diet list and a dinacharya with it. Medicines are dispensed from our own counter, panchakarma is done by trained therapists in-house, and outstation patients get their follow-ups on WhatsApp.

reviews.name: Meena D., homemaker
reviews.text: I came for years of acidity and the vaidya spent a full half hour asking about my routine before writing anything. The diet list is stuck on my fridge now. The follow-up on WhatsApp meant I did not have to take leave to visit.

reviews.name: Rajesh, shop owner
reviews.text: Took the 7-day Kati Basti course for my lower back after sitting at the counter all day. The therapist was careful, the oil was warm, and they called me the next week to check how I was sitting and sleeping.

reviews.name: Sunita P., teacher
reviews.text: My son had cold and tonsils every month. The homeopathy doctor took his full case, gave the medicines with the fee, and explained clearly what to expect. Clean clinic and very patient with children.

faq.q: Can I take Ayurvedic or homeopathic medicine along with my allopathic tablets?
faq.a: Usually yes, with a gap of 30–60 minutes, but bring every medicine and report you have to the first visit. Never stop a prescribed tablet for BP, sugar or thyroid on your own — the doctor will tell you if and when anything can change.

faq.q: How long before I see a difference?
faq.a: It depends on the complaint and how long you have had it. Acidity, sleep and acute problems often settle sooner; skin, joints and PCOS take months. The doctor gives you an honest timeline at the first visit, and reviews it every follow-up.

faq.q: What does the first visit cost, and what is included?
faq.a: Ayurveda consultation is ₹400 and homeopathy ₹450 with 15 days of medicine. Ayurvedic medicines are billed separately at the counter, typically ₹500 – ₹1,500 for a month. A follow-up within 15 days is ₹200.

faq.q: Do I need an appointment for panchakarma?
faq.a: Yes. Every therapy starts with a consultation so the vaidya can choose the oil and the sequence for you. Message us on WhatsApp with your complaint and a preferred time; therapy slots run from 9:30 am to 1 pm and 5 pm to 7:30 pm.

faq.q: Is the diet strict? I eat outside a lot.
faq.a: The list is practical — what to prefer, what to limit, and the meal timings that matter most. Many patients eat out a few times a week and still follow it. Tell the doctor your routine honestly so the plan fits your life.

faq.q: I live in another city. Can I consult online?
faq.a: The first consultation is better in person, especially for nadi pariksha. After that, follow-ups can be on WhatsApp or video call, and medicines can be couriered against UPI payment. Homeopathy cases can also be started on video.

ayurveda.address: 1st Floor, Shanti Complex, opposite Civil Hospital, Station Road
ayurveda.botPersona: Calm, respectful clinic assistant who speaks like a front-desk person at a family vaidya's clinic — helpful on timings, fees and booking, never a doctor.
ayurveda.botKnowledge: Consultation fees for Ayurveda and homeopathy and what each includes; therapy list with prices, duration and course options (Abhyanga, Shirodhara, Swedana, Kati Basti, 7-day Panchakarma, diet plan); the Diwali Detox Week offer; clinic hours, therapy slot timings and Sunday appointments; address, landmark and parking; how to book on WhatsApp and what to bring to the first visit (old reports, current medicines); online follow-up and courier of medicines for outstation patients; payment by cash and UPI. The bot never diagnoses, never suggests a medicine or dose, and never promises a result — for any health question it asks the patient to book a consultation.

reviews.name: Dr. Anjali R., clinic owner
reviews.text: They built our ground-floor clinic with two shops above it. The ramp, the wider doors for a wheelchair and the separate meter room were all planned in the drawing stage, so there were no last-minute breakages. reviews.name: Farooq, first-floor extension
reviews.text: Adding a floor on my father's old house while the whole family stayed downstairs was my biggest worry. They checked the columns first, covered the staircase with sheets and finished in five months. Dust in the first two weeks was more than expected, but the finished floor is solid and the new tenant moved in the week after handover.

faq.q: Do you charge per square foot or a lump sum, and what is the current rate?
faq.a: For new houses we quote per built-up square foot: ₹1,799 for the standard turnkey package and ₹2,249 for premium, measured as per the approved plan. Renovation and commercial work is quoted as a lump sum or item-rate BOQ after a site visit. Send your plot size, number of floors and rooms on WhatsApp and you get a stage-wise estimate within 3 working days.

faq.q: What exactly is included in the turnkey package, and which brands?
faq.a: Everything from excavation to the final coat of paint: structure, brickwork, plaster, flooring, doors, windows, electrical, plumbing, sanitary ware, painting, overhead tank, sump and compound wall up to the plinth. The brand of cement, steel, tiles, wire, pipes and fittings is written in the agreement with a model or range, and any upgrade you choose is billed at the difference only. Borewell, lift, modular kitchen and furniture are not included unless added.

faq.q: How is payment done?
faq.a: In stages, written in the agreement, usually 10% at signing, 15% at plinth, 20% at each slab, 15% at brickwork and plaster, 15% at flooring and the balance 5% at handover. Each stage is released by you after seeing the completed work and the photos. Payment is by bank transfer, cheque or UPI with a receipt and running account statement; we never ask for cash advances.

faq.q: How long will my house take?
faq.a: A 1,200 sq ft ground-plus-one house takes about 7 to 9 months from foundation to keys; a larger premium duplex 9 to 11 months. The month-wise schedule is part of the agreement and allows for the monsoon and the curing time of each slab. A delay caused by us is covered by a per-day deduction clause; delays from material changes by the owner or approval holds are recorded and added to the date.

faq.q: Can I see the houses you have built and talk to the owners?
faq.a: Yes. We share photos and short videos of completed and ongoing sites on WhatsApp, and we take you to at least two finished homes and one site under construction, usually on a Sunday morning, so you can see the plaster, the tiles and the finishing with your own eyes and ask the owners how the work went.

faq.q: Will you get the plan approved, and what about Vastu?
faq.a: We prepare the drawings and file them with the local authority or panchayat; the government fees are paid by you at actuals and we handle the follow-up. If you want a Vastu-compliant layout we plan the entrance, kitchen, puja room and master bedroom accordingly, and we are happy to incorporate changes suggested by your own Vastu consultant before the drawings are finalised.

faq.q: Do you take small jobs like one bathroom or a boundary wall?
faq.a: Yes. A single bathroom, a kitchen redo, a compound wall, a car porch or a terrace waterproofing job are all welcome and quoted as a lump sum after a visit. Send a few photos and the rough size on WhatsApp and we tell you the same day whether we can take it up and when.

reviews.name: Priya M., bank employee
reviews.text: Got a 143(1) demand of ₹38,000 that scared me. They read the notice the same evening, found that my TDS was simply not claimed, filed a rectification and the demand became zero. Fee was exactly what they told me on the first call.

reviews.name: Dr. Anil S., dental clinic
reviews.text: They moved me to 44ADA presumptive and explained in ten minutes why it suited my clinic. My ITR, the clinic's books and the project report for my new chair loan all came from one office. Only wish they had a Sunday slot.

faq.q: What documents do I need for my income tax return?
faq.a: For salaried: PAN, Aadhaar, Form 16, bank statements for the year, and proofs of investments, rent, home-loan interest or medical insurance. For a shop or profession: the same plus sales and purchase summary, bank statements of all accounts and last year's return. Message us the word ITR and a checklist for your case comes back on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do I need GST for my small shop?
faq.a: Registration becomes compulsory when turnover crosses ₹40 lakh for goods (₹20 lakh for services), or earlier if you sell on Amazon, Flipkart or to other states. Below that it is optional, but many shops register so that wholesalers and companies can buy from them. Tell us your turnover and what you sell and we will say yes or no in one message.

faq.q: Can I send everything on WhatsApp, or do I have to come to the office?
faq.a: Photos or PDFs on WhatsApp work for returns, GST, TDS and most registrations. You need to visit only for signing audit reports, physical verification for a company or when a bank wants originals. Outstation clients from the tehsils work with us fully on WhatsApp.

faq.q: I received a notice from the income tax or GST department. What should I do?
faq.a: Do not reply on your own and do not ignore it; most notices have a 15- or 30-day window. Send us the PDF on WhatsApp — the first reading and explanation is free. We tell you what it is asking, what it will cost to reply, and file the reply with the right documents.

faq.q: How are your fees decided?
faq.a: The fees on this page are fixed for standard cases. For audit, company work and notices, the fee depends on turnover and the number of entries, and we tell you the amount in writing before starting. There are no surprise charges at the end; government fees and late fees, if any, are at actuals and shown separately.

faq.q: What is the difference between the old and the new tax regime, and which should I pick?
faq.a: The new regime has lower slab rates but almost no deductions; the old regime lets you claim 80C, HRA, home-loan interest and more. Which one saves more depends on your salary structure and investments. We compute both for every return and file whichever gives the lower tax — you see both figures before we file.

faq.q: What are your timings?
faq.a: Monday to Saturday 7:30 am to 10:00 pm, Sunday 8:00 am to 10:00 pm. Breakfast items run till 11 am and samosas are fried at 4 pm and 7 pm.

faq.q: Is there Wi-Fi, and can I sit and work?

faq.q: How do I place an office order?
faq.a: WhatsApp us the number of people, what you want (chai, coffee, snacks) and the time. One hour's notice is enough for up to 30 people; for bigger orders give us a day. Delivery is free within 2 km and we can bill monthly.

faq.q: Do you make birthday cakes?
faq.a: Yes. Chocolate, vanilla, butterscotch and pineapple cakes from ₹550 per kg, eggless by default. Give us one day's notice and tell us the name to write on it. Photo cakes need two days.

faq.q: Is everything vegetarian?
faq.a: The kitchen is pure veg. Our bakes are eggless unless you ask for egg; we keep a few egg items like omelette and egg sandwich on a separate tawa.

faq.q: How do I pay, and is there parking?

faq.q: What is the minimum number of guests you cater for?
faq.a: Home functions start at 25 guests (snack boxes) or 30 plates (puja bhojan). Wedding menus start at 100–150 plates. Message us your count and we will suggest the right package.

faq.q: Is the per-plate price all-inclusive?
faq.a: The per-plate price covers food, buffet counters with warmers, crockery, disposables and one server for every 25 guests. Tables, chairs, linen and venue transport beyond 25 km are quoted separately.

faq.q: Can we taste the food before booking?
faq.a: Yes. For bookings of 200 plates or more we arrange a free tasting of 4–5 dishes at our kitchen; for smaller events a tasting is ₹1,500, adjusted in the final bill.

faq.q: Do you cook veg and non-veg in the same kitchen?
faq.a: No. Non-veg is cooked by a separate team with separate utensils and served from its own counter at the venue. Jain, no-onion-garlic and eggless menus are available too.

faq.q: How far in advance should we book?
faq.a: For wedding dates in November–February, 2–3 months ahead is safest. Birthdays and office lunches need 48 hours; a biryani handi needs 48 hours' notice.

faq.q: How does payment work?
faq.a: 25% advance confirms the date, 50% a week before the function and the balance on the day after service. We accept UPI, bank transfer and cash, and give a GST invoice for corporate bookings.

cleaning.about: We are a licensed pest control and deep cleaning service for homes, shops, offices and restaurants across the city and nearby areas. Our trained, uniformed team handles cockroach, termite, bed bug, mosquito and rodent problems, and does full-house, sofa, kitchen and water-tank cleaning with our own machines. We inspect first, tell you the charge before starting, use only approved products, and leave the place cleaner than we found it. Families with small children, pet owners and food businesses trust us because we explain every precaution and come back if the problem returns.

offer.title: Diwali Safai Offer
offer.text: Book a full home deep cleaning before Diwali and get the kitchen cockroach gel treatment free — one call, a ready home for the puja.

reviews.name: Meenakshi R., homemaker
reviews.text: We had cockroaches coming out of the kitchen drain every night for months. The gel treatment took under an hour, had no smell, and I did not have to shift a single dabba from the cabinets. It has been three months and nothing. They even called after a week to check.

reviews.name: Imran, restaurant owner
reviews.text: We took the yearly AMC for our kitchen and dining area. The team comes on the fixed date every month, early morning before we open, and leaves a filled service register that we show during inspections. Rodent problem in the store room was sorted in the first two visits.

reviews.name: Dr. Pooja S., clinic
reviews.text: Booked the deep cleaning after our clinic renovation. Four people came with a floor scrubber and a wet vacuum, and all the cement dust from the windows, grills and false ceiling corners was gone by evening. Only small thing — they reached 30 minutes late, but called ahead to tell us.

faq.q: Is the treatment safe for small children, elderly people and pets?
faq.a: Yes. For cockroach and ant control we use odourless gel bait that goes inside cabinets and cracks, so there is no spray in the open. Where a spray is needed we tell you in advance: cover food and water, keep children and pets out of that room for 3 to 4 hours, and wipe kitchen slabs once before use. Birds and aquariums are moved or covered before we start.

faq.q: Do I need to leave the house during the service?
faq.a: For gel treatment, rodent control and all cleaning work, no. For bed bug and general spray treatment we ask you to keep the treated rooms closed for 3 to 4 hours, so most families step out for lunch or do it on a Sunday morning. Termite treatment is noisy because of drilling, but you can stay in the house.

faq.q: How long does the effect last, and what if the pests come back?
faq.a: Cockroach gel treatment usually holds for 3 to 6 months; bed bugs are finished with the two-visit programme; termite treatment carries a 2-year written warranty. Every treatment comes with a free revisit within its warranty period — just send a message with a photo and we schedule it. For restaurants and offices we recommend the AMC so the visits are regular.

faq.q: Do you do termite treatment for a new house under construction?
faq.a: Yes. Pre-construction anti-termite treatment is done in three stages — foundation pits, plinth filling, and along the outer walls before flooring — at ₹9 per sq ft. Message us the stage your site is at and the plinth area, and we send a quote and visit the site the same week.

faq.q: What exactly is included in home deep cleaning?
faq.a: Every room top to bottom: ceiling fans, lights, switchboards, windows and grills, window channels, doors, wardrobes outside, kitchen cabinets inside and out, chimney exterior, gas hob, sink, bathroom tiles, taps, WC and mirrors, balcony and floor scrubbing. Not included: inside of fridge and oven, utensils, washing clothes, and terrace — these can be added at a small extra charge if you tell us while booking.

faq.q: Which areas do you cover and how do I pay?
faq.a: We cover the whole city and villages up to about 25 km; for farther sites a small travel charge is told upfront. Pay by cash, UPI or card after the work is done and you have checked it. AMC customers get a GST invoice and can pay yearly or quarterly.

reviews.text: I had never seen Accounts before Class 11 and the first month was scary. Sir made us do journal entries with actual bill copies till it became normal. The 7 am batch is early, but it means my evenings are free for self-study.

faq.q: Which boards and classes do you teach?
faq.a: Class 6 to 12 for CBSE and the State Board, in separate batches so the syllabus order matches the school. For Class 11 and 12 we run Science (PCM/PCB) and Commerce; Arts students can join for English and Economics.

faq.q: Is there a demo class, and is it really free?
faq.a: Yes. Message us the class and subject and we will tell you the next slot. The student sits through one full class, meets the teacher and sees the notes. No payment and no registration until you decide to join.

faq.q: How many students are in one batch?
faq.a: Up to 15 in Class 6 to 10, up to 20 in Class 11 and 12, and 12 in Spoken English. When a batch fills, we open a second one at a different time rather than adding benches.

faq.q: Can fees be paid monthly or in instalments?
faq.a: School-class fees are monthly, payable by the 10th by cash, UPI or bank transfer. For the three-month courses (government exams, spoken English, crash course) you can pay in two instalments; ask at the counter.

faq.q: What if my child misses a class?
faq.a: Every class is recorded. The student gets the recording link the same evening, and can bring doubts from that chapter to the 5 to 6 pm doubt counter the next day. Notes for the missed class are kept at the desk.

faq.q: How do parents know the child is actually improving?
faq.a: The Saturday test marks and the teacher's one-line remark go to the parent's WhatsApp every week. Once a month the class teacher calls each parent, and you can walk in to meet the teacher any day between 5 and 6 pm.

college.jobTitle: Degree College for Arts, Science, Commerce & Management
college.tagline: Recognised degrees, real teaching, a campus that cares
college.about: We are a co-educational degree college on College Road, running undergraduate and postgraduate courses in Arts, Science, Commerce, Management and Computer Applications, affiliated to the state university. Most of our students are the first in their family to go to college, and many come from villages and small towns around the district, so we keep fees sensible, help with every scholarship form and run a hostel and bus routes so distance is never the reason a student drops out. Classes are taken by regular, full-time faculty, attendance and internal marks are shared with parents every month, and the placement cell starts working with students from the second year, not the last semester. We do not promise jobs or ranks; we promise that every student who walks in will be taught properly, known by name and guided honestly about what comes next.

reviews.name: Pooja K., B.Com final year
reviews.text: I was the first girl in my family to go to college and my father was worried about the fee. The office filled my state scholarship form themselves and followed up till the amount came. The Tally classes got me a part-time job at a CA office in second year itself.

reviews.name: Ramesh Yadav, parent
reviews.text: My son stays in the boys' hostel and I get a message if he is absent or takes leave. The warden actually picks up the phone. Food is simple, home-style vegetarian, and the study hall being open late helped him in exams.

reviews.name: Arjun S., BCA 2025 batch
reviews.text: One computer per student made the difference. Our final-year project was a billing system for a real kirana shop and the placement cell used it in my interview preparation. Got placed with a software company in the city through the campus drive.

faq.q: Is the college recognised, and are the degrees valid for government jobs?
faq.a: Yes. The college is affiliated to the state university and all our degree courses are approved by it. The degree is issued by the university, so it is valid for government jobs, higher studies and competitive exams. You can see the affiliation letter at the office or ask us on WhatsApp.

faq.q: What is the eligibility and how is admission done?
faq.a: For UG courses you need a 12th pass certificate; B.Sc needs Science with 45% and BBA needs 50% in any stream, with relaxation as per government rules for reserved categories. Admission is on the basis of 12th marks through a merit list, and for B.A. and B.Com it is usually on first-come basis till seats last. Fill the form at the office or online, and we call you for counselling within two working days.

faq.q: Which documents do I need to bring?
faq.a: 10th and 12th marksheets and certificates, transfer certificate (TC) and character certificate from your school, Aadhaar card, caste or income certificate if applying for a scholarship, migration certificate if you are from another board, and six passport-size photos. Bring originals and two photocopies of each.

faq.q: What is the fee structure and can I pay in instalments?
faq.a: Annual fees are listed under each course on this page and include tuition, library and lab charges; university exam fees are extra and paid directly to the university. The fee can be paid in two instalments, July and January, without any extra charge. Students eligible for a state scholarship pay only the balance.

faq.q: Is there a hostel and bus facility?
faq.a: Yes. Separate girls' and boys' hostels are inside the campus with a vegetarian mess, and college buses run on six routes covering the nearby towns and villages. Message us your area or village name and we will confirm the route, pick-up time and the yearly bus fee.

faq.q: Do you help with placements after the course?
faq.a: The placement cell starts working with students from the second year with resume sessions, aptitude practice and mock interviews, and arranges campus drives by local companies, banks, retail chains and software firms. We help with every opportunity we can get, but the final result depends on the student's attendance, marks and preparation, so we never promise a job.

computer.tagline: One student, one computer. Learn by doing.
computer.about: We are a computer and skill training centre on the first floor above the main market, with 24 computers, an air-conditioned lab and batches from 7 in the morning to 8 at night. Our students are Class 10 and 12 pass-outs, college students, shop owners who want to do their own GST billing, housewives returning to work and job seekers preparing for typing tests. Every course is taught on a machine, not on a blackboard: you sit at your own computer from the first day, the trainer walks the rows, and the lab stays open for free practice between batches. Fees are written on the board at the counter, instalments are allowed on every course longer than two months, and you get a certificate with a verification number when you finish.

reviews.name: Pooja V., housewife returning to work
reviews.text: I had not touched a computer in twelve years. The 11 am batch suited me after sending the kids to school, and the trainer never made me feel slow. Finished BCC and Tally, and now I handle the billing at my husband's hardware shop myself.

reviews.name: Rahul K., SSC aspirant
reviews.text: Joined only for typing. The Saturday mock test is in the exact same format as the real exam, and the daily speed chart kept me honest. Went from 22 to 38 wpm in English in two and a half months. Hindi Mangal practice was the real help, nobody else here teaches Inscript properly.

reviews.name: Imran S., printing press owner
reviews.text: Sent my two boys for the graphic design course. They came back knowing CMYK and bleed, so our wedding card files finally print right the first time. The evening 7 pm batch meant the shop never closed. Would have liked a slightly longer CorelDRAW module.

faq.q: I have never used a computer. Which course should I start with?
faq.a: The Basic Computer Course. It starts from switching on the machine and holding the mouse, moves to typing, MS Office, internet and UPI, and the notes are in Hindi with screenshots. Most of our Tally and DCA students began exactly here.

faq.q: What are the batch timings and can I change my batch later?
faq.a: Batches run every hour from 7 am to 8 pm, Monday to Saturday, with Sunday batches for working people. If your college or shop timing changes, tell us a day before and we shift you to another batch of the same course at no cost.

faq.q: Will I get a certificate and is it valid for jobs?
faq.a: Yes. Every course ends with a practical test and you get a certificate with a unique number that anyone can verify on our website. DCA comes with a marksheet. Many offices and shops accept it; for government posts, check the exact requirement of that notification, as each one is different.

faq.q: Can I pay the fee in instalments?
faq.a: Yes, on every course longer than two months. Tally is ₹2,000 × 3, DCA is ₹1,500 × 6 and graphic design is ₹2,000 × 4. The first instalment is paid at admission; the rest are due at the start of each month. We give a printed receipt every time.

faq.q: Do I need my own laptop?
faq.a: No. You get your own computer for the full class, and the lab is free for practice between batches. If you do have a laptop at home, we help you install the same software so you can practise at night.

faq.q: Do you help with jobs after the course?
faq.a: We help you make a resume, run mock interviews and share vacancies that shops, CA offices and companies send us. We do not promise a job; the course gives you the skill that employers ask for, and the interview is yours to clear.

faq.q: Can I send mithai, pickles or home-made food?
faq.a: Yes, dry sweets, namkeen, dry fruits and sealed pickle jars go within India. Liquids and oily items must be in leak-proof containers; we double-pack them. Fresh or perishable food is not accepted. Food parcels abroad are not allowed by most countries, so please ask first.

faq.q: What do I need for an Aadhaar update?
faq.a: Bring your original Aadhaar and the proof for the change: electricity bill, bank passbook or rent agreement for address; 10th marksheet or passport for name and date of birth. A mobile-number update needs no document, only your fingerprint. The whole thing takes about 15 minutes.

faq.q: How many days does delivery take?
faq.a: Within India: metro cities 2–3 working days, other towns and district places 3–5, remote and hill areas up to 7. Abroad: Gulf 3–4 days, UK, USA, Canada and Australia 5–7. Sundays and courier holidays are not counted.

faq.q: Will you pick up the parcel from my home or shop?
faq.a: Yes, within town. Message the address and a rough weight on WhatsApp and we collect it the same day. Pickup is ₹30 within 3 km and free when there are 5 or more parcels. Shops sending daily get a fixed evening pickup.

faq.q: Is money transfer safe and how do I pay you?
faq.a: The transfer goes by IMPS to the receiver's bank account and both of you get an SMS from the bank within minutes; you get a printed receipt with the reference number. For all services we accept cash and UPI at the counter, and shops with a monthly account pay by bank transfer.

faq.q: Will the treatment hurt?
faq.a: A numbing gel is applied before the injection, and the injection makes the area numb for the whole procedure. You feel pressure and vibration, not pain. If anything bothers you, raise your left hand and we stop.

faq.q: How much does a root canal cost, and does the cap cost extra?

faq.q: Do you take dental insurance or offer EMI?

faq.q: I have sudden tooth pain. Can I come today?

faq.q: Is there a visiting charge?
faq.a: A visit and inspection charge of ₹149 applies within the city. If you go ahead with the repair the same day, it is adjusted in the final bill, so you pay only for the work.

faq.q: How soon can you come?

faq.q: Do you bring the material or should I buy it?

faq.q: Do you refill AC gas without checking for a leak?

faq.q: Is there any warranty on repairs?
faq.a: Yes. Our labour carries a 30-day warranty on general repairs and 90 days on AC leak repairs and new wiring points, written on the bill. Parts carry the maker's warranty.

faq.q: Which areas do you cover and how do I pay?

faq.q: Can I book only the DJ, or only the stage decoration, without the full package?
faq.a: Yes. Every item on this page can be booked on its own: a DJ for a sangeet, a mandap for a temple wedding, a balloon setup for a birthday, or just 200 chairs and a tent for a jagran. Message us the function, date, venue and the items you need and we send the rate for exactly that, with no pressure to add more.

faq.q: Can you do a particular theme I saw on Instagram or at a relative's wedding?
faq.a: Send us the reference photos or reel on WhatsApp. Within a day we send a drawing of how it will look on your stage size, the flowers and materials we will use and the price for fresh versus artificial flowers. Pastel, royal maroon-gold, all-white, Rajasthani, South Indian temple style and jungle or Bollywood themes are regular for us; anything new we build a sample corner of first.

faq.q: How much advance do you take, and what if the date changes?
faq.a: ₹15,000 blocks a Stage & Mandap date, ₹40,000 blocks the Full Wedding, ₹5,000 blocks a DJ night and ₹2,000 a birthday setup. The balance is paid in two parts: half when the setup is finished and checked by you, half after the function. One date change is free if you tell us 30 days ahead and we are free on the new date; otherwise the advance is adjusted against any booking in the next 12 months.

faq.q: Do you work outside the city, at farmhouses and village weddings?
faq.a: Yes. Within 40 km the transport is included in the price. Beyond that we add one truck of transport and the team's stay at actuals, usually ₹4,000 to ₹12,000 depending on the distance and the size of the setup. Village weddings in the family compound, with our own tent, lighting and generator, are common for us; send the location pin and we quote the same day.

faq.q: What about permissions and timing for DJ sound and lights?
faq.a: The local rules on timing (usually sound till 10 pm outdoors) and loudness apply, and we keep within them because a police visit spoils the night for everyone. For indoor halls we play till the hall's closing time. For an outdoor venue we tell you what the rules are at booking and, if the venue needs it, we help with the written permission application. A generator is always included, so the show does not depend on the venue's power.

faq.q: When does the setup start and who is there on the day?
faq.a: For a wedding we start the day before or at 6 am on the day, and the stage and mandap are finished at least 3 hours before guests arrive. A supervisor with a phone stays at the venue through the function for any last-minute change (a fan for the pandit, more chairs, a mic for the toast) and the team returns the same night or the next morning to wind up, so the venue is handed back clean.

Our customers are salaried people, shop owners, doctors, contractors and first-time home buyers from the city and nearby towns who want one honest person to handle the whole file instead of running bank to bank. faq.q: What documents do I need to bring for a loan?
faq.a: For any loan: PAN, Aadhaar, a photo and 6-12 months of bank statements. Salaried customers add 3 salary slips and Form 16; self-employed add 2 years of ITR with computation and GST returns. For home or property loans, the full chain of property papers. Send us photos on WhatsApp first and we tell you exactly what is missing.

faq.q: My CIBIL score is below 700. Will I get a loan?
faq.a: Some NBFCs do lend between 650 and 700 at a slightly higher rate, and a secured loan against property or gold is easier. Below 650 we usually suggest our credit score improvement plan first, so you apply once and get approved rather than getting rejected and lowering the score further. We will tell you honestly, not file a hopeless application.

faq.q: Do you give the loan yourselves? What is your fee?
faq.a: No. We are advisors and channel partners; the loan comes from a bank or NBFC and the approval and interest rate are theirs. For most home and vehicle loans the lender pays us, so you pay nothing extra. Where a fee applies, such as some business loans or a complex property file, we tell you the amount in writing before we start.

faq.q: How many days does it take to get the money?
faq.a: Personal and vehicle loans usually 3-7 working days after documents are complete. Business loans 7-15 days. Home loans and loan against property 2-4 weeks because of valuation and legal check. We share the file status on WhatsApp at every stage so you are never guessing.

faq.q: I am self-employed with cash income. Which loans can I get?
faq.a: Business loans, home loans and loan against property on the strength of your ITR, GST returns and bank statements. Some lenders also do assessed-income programmes for shopkeepers with low declared income but good bank transactions. Share your last 12 months of statements and we will match you with the right programme.

faq.q: Can I start a small SIP, and can I stop it any time?
faq.a: Yes, a SIP can start at ₹500 a month, and you can pause, stop or increase it any time without penalty; only a few funds have a small exit load if you withdraw within a year. Returns depend on the market and nobody can promise a figure, which is why we match the fund to how long you can stay invested.

faq.q: Can you make furniture in my size and design?

faq.q: Which wood do you use and what is the difference?

Engineered wood is the budget option for TV units and study tables. We show samples of all three in the showroom.

faq.q: Do you deliver and fit at home? What are the charges?
faq.a: Yes, our own team delivers and assembles the piece in your room. Delivery is free inside city limits on orders above ₹15,000; for nearby towns we charge actual transport, which we tell you before billing.

faq.q: How long does a made-to-order piece take?

faq.q: Do you repair or re-polish old furniture?
faq.a: Yes. Send photos of the sofa, bed or almirah on WhatsApp and we quote for repair, polish or new fabric. For bigger jobs we pick up and drop back; small polish work is done at your home.

faq.q: Is EMI available and how do I pay?
faq.a: Card EMI is available on purchases above ₹20,000 through most major bank cards. Otherwise 40% advance at order and balance on delivery, by cash, UPI, card or bank transfer. A proper GST bill is given with every purchase.

reviews.name: Amit K., bank employee
reviews.text: I joined the 5:30 am batch because I have to be at the branch by 9:30. The trainer wrote me a simple four-day routine in the first week and stood with me on every lift till my squat form was right. Three months in, my back pain from sitting at the desk is much better.

reviews.name: Priya S., homemaker
reviews.text: The ladies' batch at 11 is a relief — a lady trainer, nobody staring, and the plan started really light after my second delivery. The diet chart was all home food, no fancy stuff I cannot buy here. Machines are wiped down before our batch starts.

reviews.name: Ravi, shop owner
reviews.text: Took the 6:30 pm yoga batch for my knees and sleep. The instructor shows an easier version of every asana and never pushes. Only thing — the Zumba music from next door is loud on some evenings, so I go on functional days.

faq.q: What are the batch timings?
faq.a: The gym floor is open 5:30 am to 10:30 am and 4:30 pm to 9:30 pm, Monday to Saturday, with the ladies' batch from 11 am to 1 pm. Yoga runs at 6:00 am and 6:30 pm, Zumba and functional classes at 7:00 pm. Sunday is 7 am to 11 am, gym floor only.

faq.q: I have never been to a gym — will I be lost?
faq.a: No. Almost everyone here started as a beginner. In your first week the trainer walks you through every machine, writes a simple three or four-day routine and stands with you on each exercise until the form is right. You will not be handed a sheet and left alone.

faq.q: Can I take a trial before paying?
faq.a: Yes — one full session with a trainer in any batch is free. Message us on WhatsApp with a preferred time, come in shoes and comfortable clothes, and bring a water bottle. Decide on a plan only after that.

faq.q: Is there a separate batch for women?
faq.a: Yes. The 11 am to 1 pm batch is women-only with a lady trainer, a separate changing room and lockers. Women are welcome in all other batches too, and a lady trainer is on the floor in the evening batch as well.

faq.q: Do you give a diet plan?
faq.a: Basic diet guidance is included with every membership. A written chart with a body-composition reading is ₹499, and comes free with personal training and annual plans. The chart is built around home food. If you have diabetes, thyroid or any medical condition, please check the chart with your doctor.

faq.q: Can I pause my membership if I travel or fall ill?
faq.a: Yes. Monthly plans can be frozen for up to 7 days, quarterly for 15 and annual for 45 days in the year. Tell us on WhatsApp before you leave, not after you come back, and the days are added to your validity.

faq.q: How do I pay, and is there a joining fee?
faq.a: Cash, UPI or card at the desk, or UPI on WhatsApp. There is no joining fee. Quarterly and annual plans can be paid in two instalments; we share a receipt on WhatsApp for every payment.

reviews.text: Got my knee replaced here after walking with pain for two years. The physiotherapist made me walk on day two itself. The private room was clean and my wife could stay with me. Only wish the canteen opened earlier in the morning.

faq.q: Is the emergency open at night and on Sundays?
faq.a: Yes. The emergency, ICU, ambulance and pharmacy run 24 hours, every day including Sundays and holidays. A doctor is always on duty; call the emergency number and come straight in, we will keep the bed ready.

faq.q: Which doctors sit in the OPD and when?
faq.a: General physician and paediatrician sit every day 9:00 to 14:00 and 17:00 to 19:00. Gynaecologist, surgeon, orthopaedic and ENT have fixed OPD days. Message your problem on WhatsApp and we will tell you the doctor, day and time and book a token so you wait less.

faq.q: Do you accept cashless insurance and Ayushman Bharat?
faq.a: Yes. We are empanelled with most insurance TPAs and with Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY). Send a photo of your policy or scheme card on WhatsApp before admission and the insurance desk will check eligibility and start the pre-approval.

faq.q: What does a package include, and what is extra?
faq.a: Each package lists the stay, doctor fees, OT charges and ward medicines it covers. Blood, implants not named in the package, ICU care if a complication arises, and extra days are charged separately at rate-card prices. You get the estimate in writing before admission.

faq.q: What should we bring for admission?
faq.a: Aadhaar or any photo ID of the patient, old reports and prescriptions, current medicines, insurance or Ayushman card, and one attendant. For a delivery, also bring the antenatal file and the baby's clothes. Bedding and food for the attendant are available at the canteen.

faq.q: Can family stay with the patient and what are the visiting hours?
faq.a: One attendant can stay in private and general ward beds; the ICU allows family to meet the patient between 11:00 and 12:00 and 17:00 and 18:00. Children below 10 are not allowed in the ICU. Doctors meet attendants after evening rounds to explain progress.

insurance.jobTitle: LIC Agent & Insurance Advisor — Life, Health & Motor
insurance.tagline: The right cover for your family, no pressure
insurance.about: We are an LIC agency and insurance advisory office near the Civil Lines bus stand, serving families, shopkeepers, teachers and salaried people from the city and the nearby tehsils. People come to us for term and savings plans from LIC, health insurance for the whole family, and car and two-wheeler policies — but mostly they stay because of what happens after the policy: a reminder before every premium date, a nominee or address change done the same day, and someone who sits with them at the hospital counter or the LIC branch when a claim has to be filed. We write every plan on one sheet — premium, term, what the family gets and when — so you decide at home, in your own time, and nobody is sold a policy they do not understand.

products.name: Term Life Cover — ₹1 Crore
products.desc: Pure protection for the family: if something happens to the earning member during the term, the nominee receives the full sum assured. The lowest premium per rupee of cover that exists; every family with a loan or children should start here.
features: ₹50 lakh to ₹2 crore cover, 20 to 40 year term

products.name: Savings + Life Cover Plan (Endowment)
products.desc: The classic LIC way to save: a fixed premium for 15 to 25 years, a lump sum at maturity with the bonus declared by the insurer each year, and life cover for the family throughout. Suited to people who want a disciplined, safe saving they will not touch.
features: Maturity amount plus yearly bonus as declared by LIC
Life cover for the family during the whole term
Loan against the policy after three years
Premium qualifies under Section 80C; maturity as per Section 10(10D)

products.name: Money-Back Plan
products.desc: A savings plan that pays part of the sum assured back to you every five years while the policy runs, with the balance and the bonus at maturity. Good for people who like money coming back at intervals — school admission, a daughter's wedding, a shop expansion.
features: Survival payouts every 5 years during the term
Full sum assured to the family on death, even after payouts

products.desc: Started in the child's name when they are small, so that a fixed sum is ready at 18, 20 and 22 for college and later for marriage. If the parent paying the premium is no more, future premiums are waived and the plan continues for the child.

products.name: Pension / Retirement Plan

offer.text: Bring every policy your family holds — LIC, health, vehicle, any company — before 15 November and we hand you one sheet with your total cover, the premium calendar and what is missing. No fee, no obligation to buy.

reviews.name: Sunita D., school teacher
reviews.text: My husband's policy had lapsed for two years after he lost the receipt book. Sir got it revived with one medical form and sat with me at the branch himself. Now the reminder comes on WhatsApp ten days before every premium.

reviews.name: Mohammed F., garment shop owner
reviews.text: My father was admitted in the night and I had no idea about cashless. One call at 11 pm and he had the TPA desk sorted by morning; we paid nothing except the non-medical items. He had told me on day one to keep the health card in my wallet, and that is what saved us.

reviews.name: Ankit R., bank employee
reviews.text: I went in for a ₹25 lakh term plan and came out with ₹1 crore for only ₹400 more a month because he showed the numbers on paper and did not push any savings plan. Honest comparison. Only thing — the office closes at seven, so I had to come on a Saturday.

faq.q: Which policy should I take first — term, savings or health?
faq.a: For most families: a term plan of 10 to 15 times your yearly income first, then a health floater for the whole family, and only after that a savings or child plan with whatever is left each month. Tell us your age, the family members and roughly what you can set aside, and we send you two or three options on one sheet with the premium for each.

faq.q: How much will my premium actually be?
faq.a: The premiums on this page are samples for a given age and cover. Your exact figure depends on age, smoking, health, the term and the sum assured, and we quote it from the insurer's own calculator before you pay a rupee. Life insurance premiums are the same whether you buy through us or anywhere else; the difference is who helps you at renewal and claim.

faq.q: What documents do I need to start a policy?
faq.a: PAN, Aadhaar, a passport photo and a bank cancelled cheque for every policy. For term and larger life covers, add income proof (salary slips, ITR or Form 16) and a medical test, which we arrange at your home or a nearby centre. For vehicle insurance, only the RC and the previous policy. We fill the forms with you; you just sign.

faq.q: What happens at claim time? Will you help?
faq.a: Yes, that is the main reason to have an agent. Message us first — for a hospital, before admission if possible, so cashless is arranged at the TPA desk; for a death claim, we come home, prepare the claimant statement, death certificate, bond and bank details, submit them at the branch and follow up till the amount is credited to the nominee. We stay with the family through the whole process.

faq.q: My LIC policy lapsed two years ago. Can it be revived?
faq.a: Usually yes. LIC allows revival within five years of the first unpaid premium by paying the arrears with interest and, depending on the gap and the sum assured, a health declaration or a medical. Send the policy number on WhatsApp and we tell you the exact revival amount and what is needed; if revival does not make sense, we say so.

faq.q: Can you service a policy I bought online or from another agent?
faq.a: For LIC policies, yes — premium payment, reminders, nominee and address changes, loans and claims can be done through our office whoever sold the policy. For health and vehicle policies from other insurers, we renew them with you and help at claim time. Share the policy copy on WhatsApp and we confirm what we can do.

It explains in plain words the difference between term and savings plans, what a family floater and cashless mean, what a no-claim bonus is, and the 80C and 80D tax sections. It never quotes a final premium, promises a return, bonus or claim outcome, or gives medical or legal advice; for anything that depends on the person's age, health or policy papers it asks them to send the details on WhatsApp so the advisor can check with the insurer's calculator.

faq.q: How much does a website cost and what is included?
faq.a: A 5-page business website is ₹14,999 and includes design, a .com or .in domain, hosting and SSL for one year, WhatsApp and map buttons, basic SEO and two rounds of changes. An online store starts at ₹34,999. Tell us your business and what you want on the site and a fixed quote comes back on WhatsApp the same day; the price does not change mid-way.

faq.q: How long will it take to go live?
faq.a: A business website takes 7 to 10 working days once we have your logo, photos and content; an online store 3 to 4 weeks; an app 6 to 8 weeks. The biggest delay is usually content from the client's side, so we send a simple checklist on day one and can write the text for you from a 15-minute call.

faq.q: Will the domain and website be in my name?
faq.a: Yes. The domain is registered on your email and phone number, hosting is in your account, and after full payment you get the login details and all files. If you ever move to another developer, nothing is locked with us.

faq.q: Can I change prices and photos myself later?

faq.q: Do you run ads too, and what does it really cost?
faq.a: Yes, Google and Meta ads. Our management fee is ₹5,999 a month; the ad spend is separate, paid by you directly to Google or Meta from your own account, and you decide the budget. We suggest starting at ₹10,000 a month for a city campaign and tell you the cost per lead every week.

faq.q: I already have a website that is slow or outdated. Can you fix it?
faq.a: Send the link on WhatsApp. Within a day we tell you whether it is worth repairing or should be rebuilt on your existing domain, with a price for each. Speed fixes and a fresh design on the same domain usually cost less than a new site.

faq.q: How do I pay?
faq.a: 50% advance to start, 50% at launch, by UPI or bank transfer; monthly services are billed on the 1st. We give a GST invoice for every payment, so the cost can go into your business books.

faq.q: Is all your gold BIS hallmarked?

kirana.about: We are a family-run kirana store on Station Road, serving the homes, hostels and small canteens of our neighbourhood since the days when atta still came in paper bags. From chakki atta, dal and khula masala weighed in front of you to branded oil, dairy, biscuits and household cleaning, we keep everything a kitchen runs on under one roof. Every packet is date-checked before it goes into your bag, every item is billed at printed MRP or lower, and a WhatsApp list in the morning reaches your door by evening. Walk in, call, or send a photo of your list — we know most of our customers' monthly orders by heart.

reviews.name: Sunita M., homemaker
reviews.text: I send a photo of my handwritten list on the 1st of every month and it arrives by evening, packed exactly as written. Last month they called to say the ghee I wanted was out of stock and suggested another brand instead of just skipping it. That is the difference from an app.

reviews.name: Rakesh, hostel warden
reviews.text: They supply atta, rice and oil for our 60-bed boys' hostel every Monday without fail. The bags are weighed in front of our cook and we get one clean bill at month end, which makes the accounts easy.

reviews.name: Priya & Arjun, working couple
reviews.text: The milk, bread and egg pack at 7 am has removed one daily headache. We paused it for a week's holiday with one message and the bill adjusted itself. Would love if curd was added by default too.

faq.q: Do you deliver at home, and is there a minimum order?
faq.a: Yes. Delivery is free within 2 km for orders above ₹300; smaller orders and farther areas carry a ₹30 – ₹50 charge, which we tell you before packing. Lists sent before 1 pm go out the same evening between 5 and 8 pm.

faq.q: Can I order my whole month's ration in one go?
faq.a: Yes, that is what most of our regular customers do. Send your list once on WhatsApp or hand it over at the counter; we save it, pack it on your chosen date every month and send a reminder two days before so you can add or remove items.

faq.q: Do you sell loose (khula) items or only packets?
faq.a: Both. Atta, rice, dal, sugar, poha, besan and whole spices are available khula and weighed in front of you from 250 g upwards. Branded packets are also stocked for those who prefer sealed packs.

faq.q: What if something is damaged, expired or the wrong item?
faq.a: Bring it back or show us a photo on WhatsApp with the bill and we replace it on the next delivery, no questions. We check dates on every packet before packing, but if anything slips through it is our mistake, not yours.

faq.q: Do you keep a specific brand I use?
faq.a: We stock the brands people in the area ask for most. If yours is not on the shelf, message us the name and pack size; we usually get it from the distributor within 2 – 3 days and keep it stocked once you order it regularly.

faq.q: How can I pay?
faq.a: Cash, UPI and cards at the counter. For WhatsApp orders and deliveries we send a UPI payment link or you pay the delivery boy by UPI or cash. Regular customers can run a monthly khata settled on the 1st.

For items not stocked, it offers to check with the distributor rather than promising. lawyer.jobTitle: B.A., LL.B. — Advocate, District & Sessions Court
lawyer.tagline: Honest advice first, strong representation after
lawyer.about: We run a small, busy law chamber on Court Road, two minutes from the District Court gate, for families, shopkeepers, tenants, landlords and small businesses who need a lawyer they can actually reach. Adv. Your Name has practised for over a decade in civil, property, family, cheque-bounce and criminal matters, and appears regularly in the District & Sessions Court, consumer forum, family court and the High Court on appeals. Every new matter starts with a proper consultation where we read your papers, tell you plainly whether a case is worth fighting, what it will cost and how long it may take. Our drafting is done in-house, every hearing date is updated to you on WhatsApp the same evening, and nothing you tell us leaves this office.

offer.title: Free 15-minute first call for new clients
offer.text: Send a short message about your matter on WhatsApp and we call you back the same working day for a free 15-minute first discussion, so you know whether it is worth a full consultation before you spend anything.

reviews.name: Sunil K., hardware shop owner
reviews.text: A dealer bounced a cheque of ₹1.8 lakh and kept avoiding my calls. The legal notice went out within two days and he settled the full amount before the court date. The fee was told to me in writing before anything started.

reviews.name: Priya M., school teacher
reviews.text: Came for my parents' will. Sir sat with them for almost an hour, explained every line in Hindi and arranged the registration date himself. My mother felt heard, which matters more than anything.

reviews.name: Rakesh, tenant
reviews.text: Landlord refused to return the deposit after I vacated. One notice from this chamber and the money came in three weeks. The WhatsApp updates after every step meant I never had to chase anyone.

faq.q: What should I bring to the first consultation?
faq.a: Every paper connected to the matter: the notice or FIR copy, agreements, receipts, bank statements, photos, WhatsApp chats and your ID. If you send photos of the papers on WhatsApp a day earlier, we read them before you come and the 30 minutes are used properly.

faq.q: How are your fees decided and when do I pay?
faq.a: Drafting work such as notices, agreements and wills has a fixed price listed on this page. For court matters the fee is stage-wise — filing, evidence, arguments — and written down at the first meeting so there are no surprises. Court fees, stamp duty and process fees are paid at actuals with receipts. Cash, UPI and bank transfer are all accepted.

faq.q: Can you tell me whether I will win my case?
faq.a: No advocate can promise a result, and you should be careful of anyone who does. What we do is read your papers and tell you honestly where the matter is strong, where it is weak, and whether settling is a better option than fighting.

faq.q: Which courts do you appear in?
faq.a: The District & Sessions Court, family court, consumer forum, labour court and the Sub-Registrar office here in the city, and the High Court for appeals, bail and writ matters. For a matter in another district we can either travel or connect you with a trusted colleague there.

faq.q: Will I get updates on my hearing dates?
faq.a: Yes. After every hearing you receive a WhatsApp message the same evening saying what happened and what the next date is. You do not need to attend every date; we tell you clearly which ones need your presence.

faq.q: Is my matter kept confidential?
faq.a: Completely. What you share with us is protected by advocate-client privilege. Your papers are kept in a locked file, your case is never discussed with anyone outside the chamber, and family matters are heard in a separate cabin, not the open office.

The bot never gives legal advice, never predicts the outcome of a case, never quotes a fee that is not on this page and never discusses another client's matter; for anything urgent such as an arrest it asks the person to call the chamber number directly.

medical.tagline: Genuine medicines, checked by a pharmacist
medical.about: We are a licensed medical store on Station Road, opposite the Civil Hospital gate, serving the families, senior citizens and hospital visitors of our town for every prescription, big or small. Our counter is run by a registered pharmacist who reads the dose, checks the expiry and the batch, and explains how and when to take each medicine before the bill is printed. We stock prescription and generic medicines, surgical and first-aid supplies, baby care, nutrition and home health devices like BP monitors, glucometers and nebulisers, with insulin and other cold-chain items kept in a temperature-logged fridge. Send a photo of your prescription on WhatsApp and we pack it, confirm the bill and deliver within 3 km, and for regular BP, sugar and thyroid patients we keep the month's medicines ready before you even remember.

reviews.name: Rakesh, caretaker of his father
reviews.text: Papa takes nine medicines a day and I used to miss one or the other every month. Now a message comes three days before, the pack arrives on the 2nd, and the bill is on WhatsApp. One worry gone.

reviews.name: Farhan K., college student
reviews.text: Sent a photo of my prescription at 9 at night when I had fever and it reached the hostel gate in forty minutes. They also called to say one tablet was to be taken after food, which the doctor had not told me.

faq.q: Do you deliver medicines at home?
faq.a: Yes, within 3 km of the store, usually within 2 hours and the same day for orders received before 8 pm. Send the prescription photo and your address on WhatsApp; delivery is free on bills above ₹500 and ₹30 below that.

faq.q: Do I need a prescription for every medicine?
faq.a: For scheduled medicines (antibiotics, BP, sugar, sleep and pain medicines etc.) a doctor's prescription is required by law and we keep a copy. Over-the-counter items like ORS, antacids, band-aids, vitamins and baby products can be bought without one.

faq.q: Can you give a cheaper generic instead of the brand written?
faq.a: We can show you the generic with the same salt and strength and its price, but we change the brand only after you confirm with your doctor. For long-term medicines many doctors are happy to write the generic if you ask.

faq.q: What if a medicine is not in stock?
faq.a: We order it from the distributor the same day; most medicines arrive by the next morning and rare ones in 2 – 3 days. We message you the moment it reaches and can deliver it directly.

faq.q: Can I return or exchange medicines?
faq.a: Unopened, uncut strips and sealed items can be exchanged within 7 days with the bill. Insulin and other fridge medicines, cut strips, syrups and opened devices cannot be taken back, as per drug rules.

faq.q: Can you suggest a medicine for my fever or cough?
faq.a: We can only dispense what a doctor has prescribed and guide you on over-the-counter basics like ORS or a thermometer. For any symptom please consult a doctor; the Civil Hospital OPD is across the road and we can share nearby clinic timings.
