faq.q: How early should I book for a wedding?
faq.a: Four to six weeks for bridal makeup and mehndi, so there is time for a trial; for peak dates in November, December and February, book two months ahead. An advance of ₹1,000 blocks the date, and we fix the trial at the same time.

faq.q: Do you come home or to the venue?
faq.a: Yes. All bridal, engagement and group bookings are done at your home, hotel room or banquet hall; we bring the complete kit, chairs and lights if needed. Party makeup for one or two people can be done at our studio or at home with a ₹300 visit charge within the city.

faq.q: Which products do you use, and are they safe for sensitive skin?
faq.a: Professional makeup brands for base, eyes and setting, with waterproof and long-wear ranges for brides. Mehndi cones are made by hand with natural henna, eucalyptus and clove oil, no chemical dyes. If your skin is sensitive, tell us at the trial so we can patch-test.

faq.q: When should bridal mehndi be done, and how do I get a dark stain?
faq.a: Two days before the wedding is ideal; the stain darkens over 48 hours. Keep the mehndi on for 6 to 8 hours, dab with sugar-lemon water, avoid water for 12 hours after removing it and apply a little mustard oil or balm. We share the full aftercare on WhatsApp after your session.

faq.q: Can you handle makeup for the whole family on the same day?
faq.a: Yes, with a second artist for four or more people, so the bride never waits. Share the number of people and the time of the function, and we send a schedule so everyone is ready on time.

faq.q: Do you travel for outstation weddings, and how do I pay?
faq.a: Yes, we do destination and hometown weddings outside the city; travel and stay are added to the package and shared with you in advance. Payment is 20 percent advance to block the date, and the balance on the day by UPI or cash.

faq.q: What exactly is included in a wedding package and what costs extra?
faq.a: Each package lists the number of photographers, hours, edited photos, albums and films. Travel within 50 km, the online gallery and the USB drive are included. Extra hours are ₹2,500 per photographer per hour, a drone is ₹4,000 per function where permitted, extra albums are ₹6,500 to ₹9,500 depending on pages, and outstation travel and stay are billed at actuals. We send a written quote so nothing surprises you later.

faq.q: When will I get my photos and video?
faq.a: A teaser of 10 to 25 photos reaches you the next day for your status and family groups. Selected photos come within 7 to 10 days. The full edited gallery takes 45 days for a single-day wedding and 60 days for a full wedding; films take 75 days because every song and ritual is edited by hand. The dates are written on your booking slip.

faq.q: Can I see full albums from earlier weddings, not just the best shots?
faq.a: Yes. Visit the studio or ask on WhatsApp and we share two or three complete wedding galleries and a physical album, so you see how we cover the rituals, the family photos and the slow parts of the day, not just the highlights.

faq.q: Do you shoot outside the city or at destination weddings?
faq.a: Yes. Within 50 km travel is included. Beyond that, we add train or car fare and a simple stay for the team at actuals, usually ₹3,000 to ₹6,000 per person per day depending on the place. Udaipur, Jaipur, Goa and hill-station weddings are regular for us; send the venue and dates and we quote the same day.

faq.q: How much advance is needed and what if the date changes?
faq.a: ₹10,000 blocks a Wedding Day booking and ₹30,000 blocks a Full Wedding; smaller shoots need ₹2,000. The balance is paid in two parts, half before the event and half when the gallery is delivered. One date change is free if you tell us at least 30 days before and we are free on the new date; the advance is otherwise adjusted against any future shoot within a year.

faq.q: Can I get passport photos without an appointment, and in which sizes?
faq.a: Yes, walk in during studio hours. We shoot, size and print in about 10 minutes and WhatsApp the soft copy. Indian passport 35x45 mm with white background, US visa 2x2 inch, PAN, Aadhaar, school and government forms, matrimony and biodata photos are all available; tell us the form and we match its exact requirement.

playschool.tagline: Where the first school day feels like home
playschool.about: We are a play school and daycare for children from 1 year 8 months to 5½ years, in a ground-floor bungalow with its own garden on Shastri Nagar Road, two lanes behind the Civil Hospital. Children come to us for Play Group, Nursery, LKG and UKG, and working parents leave their little ones with us till 6 in the evening in our daycare. Every class has one teacher and one didi for at most 15 children, so a shy child, a child who still wears a diaper, or a child who speaks only Marwari at home is seen and settled, not lost in a crowd. The whole day is built around play — rhymes, blocks, sand, water, colour, stories and the garden — and the letters and numbers arrive gently, in UKG, when the hands and the mind are ready. Parents get a photo and a two-line note on WhatsApp every afternoon, and the gate, the garden and every room are on CCTV that the owner watches from the office.

features: Maximum 15 children per class
Toilet training with the didi, no scolding
Weekly theme: farm, rain, my family, Diwali

reviews.name: Neha T., mother of a Nursery child
reviews.text: My son cried at two other schools and we had given up. Here the teacher let me sit in the classroom for the first week and the didi, Sunita, learnt the words he uses at home. reviews.name: Rajesh & Pooja, both working parents
reviews.text: We needed daycare till 6 and were scared of leaving a two-and-a-half-year-old that long. The same two didis are with the children every day, the nap mattresses are clean, and when our daughter had a fever the owner called us herself within ten minutes. The only thing we would like is a Saturday option every week, not just on request.

reviews.name: Dr. Meenakshi R., mother of a UKG child
reviews.text: As a paediatrician I looked at the toilets, the drinking water and the hand-washing routine before anything else, and they passed. My daughter learnt to read three-letter words through phonics, not by memorising, and she got into Class 1 at the school we wanted without any coaching.

faq.q: From what age do you take children, and which class will my child go to?
faq.a: We take children from 1 year 8 months. Play Group is up to 2½ years, Nursery 2½ to 3½, LKG 3½ to 4½ and UKG 4½ to 5½, with the age counted on 31 March of the admission year. Send us the date of birth on WhatsApp and we will tell you the class and whether a seat is open.

faq.q: What are the timings, and is there daycare?
faq.a: Play Group runs 9:30 to 11:30 am, Nursery 9 am to 12 noon, LKG till 12:30 and UKG till 1 pm, Monday to Friday. Daycare continues after class till 3 pm (half day) or 6 pm (full day) with lunch, nap and snack. Saturday care is available on request at ₹250 a day; Sunday we are closed.

faq.q: How do you keep the children safe?
faq.a: One teacher and one didi stay with at most 15 children, the gate is locked during school hours with a guard, and every room, the garden and the gate are on CCTV watched from the office. Children are handed over only to the two or three people whose photos are on the child's pick-up card. Furniture is rounded, plug points are covered, and the water is RO-filtered. We are happy to show you all of this on your visit.

faq.q: What does my child need to bring, and what about food?
faq.a: A water bottle and a small tiffin with home food for the 11 o'clock snack — fruit, paratha, idli, poha, anything without chocolates or chips. Daycare children bring lunch or take ours at ₹600 a month (dal, rice, roti, sabzi, curd, with fruit at 4:30). Please tell us about any allergy in the admission form; we keep nut-free days when a child needs them.

faq.q: What documents are needed for admission?
faq.a: The child's birth certificate, the child's Aadhaar if made, Aadhaar of both parents, four passport photos of the child and two each of the parents and of anyone who will pick up the child, and the vaccination card. The form takes ten minutes at the office, or we can send it on WhatsApp to fill at home.

faq.q: My child cries a lot and is not toilet trained — is that a problem?
faq.a: Not at all; most children arrive this way. For the first week a parent or grandparent may sit in the class, and we settle the child over short days before the full timing. Toilet training is done calmly by the didi, with a changing room for diapers in Play Group and Nursery, and no child is ever scolded for an accident.

faq.q: What is the total fee for a year, and how do we pay?
faq.a: For Nursery, for example: ₹3,000 admission (one time) plus ₹2,000 a month for 12 months, plus books and the admission kit. Fees can be paid monthly, quarterly or for the year by UPI, card or cash at the office, and we send a receipt on WhatsApp for every payment. There is a 5% concession for paying the full year in April and for a second sibling.

faq.q: I only have the text and my logo. Can you design it?
faq.a: Yes. Send the matter, logo and a reference you like on WhatsApp. For cards, flex and pamphlets the basic design is free with printing; you get a proof to approve before anything is printed.

faq.q: Which file should I send for printing?
faq.a: A PDF with 3 mm bleed is best. CDR, AI or PSD files also work. A JPG from the phone is fine for flex boards, but for visiting cards and pamphlets we need at least 300 DPI, or we redesign it for you.

faq.q: How fast can you do an urgent job?

faq.q: What is the minimum quantity?
faq.a: Digital printing has no real minimum: 100 visiting cards, 50 pamphlets or 25 wedding cards are fine. Offset rates start at 1,000 pieces, and the rate per piece drops sharply at 5,000.

faq.q: Can I see wedding card samples before ordering?
faq.a: Yes. There is a sample book of 200+ designs at the counter, or tell us your budget per card and colour on WhatsApp and we send photos of 8 to 10 matching designs.

faq.q: Do you deliver, and how do I pay?
faq.a: Jobs above ₹2,000 are delivered free within the city; outside the city we send by courier at actual cost. For orders above ₹5,000 we take 50% advance and the balance on delivery, by cash, UPI or bank transfer, with a GST bill.

reviews.name: Priya & Ankit, first home buyers
reviews.text: We had almost paid a token on a flat elsewhere when they showed us the society had a pending loan on the land. They found us the Shanti Nagar 2 BHK instead, came with us to three banks and sat at the registry office till 6 pm. Our parents still say the brokerage was worth it.

reviews.name: Mahendra, retired teacher
reviews.text: I wanted to sell my Gandhi Nagar house but did not want strangers walking in every day. They screened buyers on the phone first, brought only four families, and the deal closed at ₹2 lakh above what the neighbour's broker had quoted. Payment came through the bank, no cash games.

reviews.name: Farhan, NRI owner in Dubai
reviews.text: My flat was lying vacant for a year. They found a doctor's family as tenants, sent me the police verification and the agreement on WhatsApp, and the rent reaches my account on the 5th every month. They even got the geyser repaired and sent the bill.

faq.q: What is your brokerage and when is it paid?
faq.a: For sale and purchase it is the standard 1 percent of the deal value from each side, told to you in writing before the first visit. For rentals it is one month's rent from the tenant and one from the owner. Nothing is paid until the agreement is signed; a part comes at agreement and the rest at registry or key handover.

faq.q: Do you check the property papers yourselves?
faq.a: Yes. Before we take you for a visit we look at the registry chain, mutation or khatauni, colony approval, electricity and tax dues, and whether any bank loan or court stay is on the property. For the final deal we arrange a written opinion from a property lawyer, which costs around ₹2,500 to ₹5,000 and is worth every rupee.

faq.q: Can you help me get a home loan on the property?
faq.a: Yes. Once you shortlist, we send the property papers to two or three banks together so you get sanction letters to compare. We help with your income documents, sit with the bank valuer at the site and follow up till disbursal. The bank decides the rate and approval, not us, and we never promise one.

faq.q: I live in another city. Can I buy or sell through you without coming?
faq.a: Most of it, yes. We do video visits on WhatsApp, share papers as PDFs and keep you on call during bargaining. For the registry you have to be present or give a registered power of attorney to a relative; we guide you on that too. Several NRI owners rent out and sell through us this way.

faq.q: How long does it take to sell a flat or plot?
faq.a: A fairly priced flat in a settled colony usually finds a buyer in 4 to 10 weeks; plots and shops can take 2 to 4 months. We value it from actual recent deals in your area, not a hopeful number, and tell you honestly if the asking price needs to come down.

faq.q: Can I see properties on a Sunday or in the evening?
faq.a: Yes. Site visits run from 9 am to 7 pm on all days including Sunday; message us a day ahead with the properties you want to see and we plan the route so you cover three or four in one trip. Office walk-in is Monday to Saturday.

school.jobTitle: Nursery to Class 12, CBSE, English medium
school.tagline: Every child known by name, every day
school.about: We are a co-educational English-medium school from Nursery to Class 12, running on the CBSE syllabus with Hindi as the second language and Sanskrit or Computer Science as the third-language choice. Our campus on the bypass road has airy classrooms, a library, two science labs, a computer lab, a games field and a shaded play area for the little ones, with school buses running on fixed routes across the town and nearby villages. Families choose us for the middle path: serious studies with regular tests and homework, but also sports, music, art and stage time for every child, not just the toppers. Class sizes are kept small enough that the class teacher knows each child's strengths and weak spots, and parents hear from us every month, not only at report-card time.

products.name: Middle School: Class 6 to 8

offer.text: Register before 31 January for the new session and we waive the ₹5,000 to ₹8,000 admission fee; siblings of current students get 10% off the monthly tuition fee for the whole year.

reviews.name: Priya Sharma, mother of a Class 3 student
reviews.text: My daughter was shy and barely spoke in her last school. Here the class teacher noticed within a month and gave her small roles in the morning assembly. Now she reads the news in English on stage. The diary is signed every single day, so I always know what happened in class.

reviews.name: Rakesh Yadav, father of a Class 10 student
reviews.text: The three pre-boards made the real difference for my son. The answer sheets came back with remarks on where marks were being lost, and the Saturday doubt class was free, no separate coaching needed. We saved on tuition fees outside and he was far more confident in the board exam.

reviews.name: Meena and Sunil Verma, parents of Nursery and Class 6 students
reviews.text: Two children, one bus, and the lady attendant knows both by name. The live bus location on the app means I am not standing at the gate for twenty minutes. Only wish the canteen had more options, but the tiffin break is well managed.

faq.q: What is the age for Nursery admission?
faq.a: The child should be 3 years old by 31 March of the admission year; LKG is 4+ and UKG is 5+ on the same date. We can take a child a few months younger into Nursery after a short interaction with the pre-primary teacher.

faq.q: Which documents do we need to submit?
faq.a: Birth certificate, four passport-size photos of the child and one each of both parents, Aadhaar copies of the child and parents, address proof, and for Class 2 onwards the previous year's report card and the Transfer Certificate from the last school. Caste or EWS certificate only if you are applying under a reserved category.

faq.q: Is there any entrance test?
faq.a: No test up to Class 1; we meet the child and the parents for about 15 minutes. From Class 2 to 9 there is a short written check in English, Hindi and Maths so we place the child correctly and plan remedial help if needed. Class 11 admission is on the Class 10 marks and the stream chosen.

faq.q: Can the fee be paid in instalments?
faq.a: Yes. Tuition fee is collected quarterly (April, July, October, January) at the school office or through the parent app by UPI or card. Paying the full year in April gets a 5% discount on tuition. Bus fee is monthly or quarterly, as you prefer.

faq.q: Does the school bus come to our area?
faq.a: We run nine fixed routes covering the town and the villages along the main highway, up to about 15 km from school. Send us your locality on WhatsApp and we will tell you the nearest stop, the pick-up time and the monthly charge for that route.

faq.q: Which board does the school follow, and what about Hindi?
faq.a: We follow the CBSE syllabus with NCERT books from Class 1 to 12. The medium of instruction is English; Hindi is taught as a compulsory second language till Class 10, and Sanskrit or Computer Science is the third-language option from Class 6 to 8.

Steam free with every session

8-session package at ₹9,499

services.name: Steam & hot shower
services.desc: Add a 15-minute steam before any massage; towels, slippers and a shower kit are provided.

services.name: Lady therapist on request
services.desc: Female guests are attended by a lady therapist in the separate ladies' wing — just say so when booking.

services.name: Pressure & oil consultation
services.desc: Two minutes before every session: where it hurts, light or firm, which oil — and the therapist adjusts mid-way if you ask.

services.name: Couple & group bookings
services.desc: Two beds in the couple room; friends' groups, kitty parties and bridal parties get back-to-back slots.

services.name: Gift vouchers
services.desc: Printed or WhatsApp vouchers for any treatment or amount, valid six months — a birthday, anniversary or Raksha Bandhan gift that is actually used.

services.name: Office & hotel visits

offer.title: Diwali Gift Voucher Offer
offer.text: Buy gift vouchers worth ₹3,000 or more before Diwali and get a free 30-minute Head, Neck & Shoulder massage for yourself.

reviews.name: Priya M., IT professional
reviews.text: I booked the deep tissue for my laptop shoulders and the therapist actually asked where it hurt before starting instead of doing a set routine. Lady therapist, separate wing, fresh sheets on the bed — I could see them being changed. Went back the next week.

reviews.name: Rajesh K., cloth merchant
reviews.text: After the Surat trip my legs were dead. Foot reflexology and a steam, forty-five minutes, no one rushed me and the tulsi tea at the end was a nice touch. Parking in the plaza basement is easy, which matters on MG Road.

reviews.name: Neha & Arjun, anniversary
reviews.text: Took the couple ritual for our fifth anniversary. Candles, soft music, both beds in one room, and they had the cake we asked for waiting with the tea. Only wish the steam room were a little bigger.

faq.q: Do I need to book in advance?
faq.a: Yes, please — we have six rooms and one couple room, and evenings and weekends fill up. Message us the treatment and a time on WhatsApp; we confirm within a few minutes. Weekday afternoons often have walk-in slots for head or foot massage.

faq.q: Can I ask for a lady or a gents therapist?
faq.a: Yes. Female guests are attended by lady therapists in the ladies' wing by default; male guests get a male therapist. Tell us any preference when booking and we arrange it.

faq.q: What should I wear or bring?
faq.a: Nothing special. We give disposable wear, slippers, a towel set and a locker for your things. Come 10 minutes early, avoid a heavy meal just before, and skip jewellery if you can.

faq.q: What if the pressure is too much or too little?
faq.a: Just say so — the therapist checks once at the start and once mid-way, and will change it any time you ask. Nobody has to 'bear it'.

faq.q: Is massage okay during pregnancy or after surgery?
faq.a: Please ask your doctor first and tell us before the session. We do not do deep tissue or abhyanga in pregnancy or within six weeks of surgery; a gentle head or foot massage may be possible with your doctor's okay.

faq.q: How do I pay, and can I reschedule?
faq.a: Cash, UPI and cards at the counter; packages and couple bookings are paid in advance. You can reschedule free up to 3 hours before your slot; a no-show on a couple booking forfeits the advance.

spa.address: 2nd Floor, Galaxy Plaza, above the pharmacy, MG Road — basement parking
spa.botPersona: A soft-spoken spa front-desk host — polite, unhurried, helps you pick a treatment and a slot, and never gives medical advice.
spa.botKnowledge: The full treatment list with price, duration, pressure and what each is best for (Swedish, deep tissue, abhyanga, head-neck-shoulder, foot reflexology, body scrub, couple ritual, monthly package); add-ons like steam, hair wash and combining a scrub with a massage; lady or gents therapist choice and the ladies' wing; what to wear and bring, lockers and disposable wear; the Diwali gift voucher offer and how vouchers are sent and redeemed; hours, last-booking time, the couple room availability and how to book on WhatsApp; address, landmark and basement parking; reschedule and no-show rules; payment by cash, UPI and card with packages paid in advance; office chair-massage and hotel visits by prior booking. For pregnancy, surgery or any health condition the bot asks the guest to consult their doctor and to inform the therapist — it never promises relief or a result.

sweets.tagline: Desi ghee mithai, made fresh every morning
sweets.about: We are a family-run sweet shop and bakery on Main Market Road, feeding this town's festivals, weddings and evening chai for two generations. Our halwais start at 5 am so the kaju katli, motichoor laddoo and rasmalai on the counter were made that same morning — in pure desi ghee, with khoya we thicken ourselves and no colours or essences we would not serve our own children. From a 250 g box for a guest to 500 laddoo boxes for a wedding, every order gets the same khoya, the same ghee and the same care in packing. Walk in and taste before you buy, or send your list on WhatsApp and we deliver across the city.

products.name: Kaju Katli — Diamond Cut
products.desc: Thin, silver-leaf kaju katli made from whole W320 cashews ground fresh in-house. Melts clean on the tongue with no sticky after-taste — the box most guests ask about.
features: Whole cashew, no peanut or besan mixed
Edible silver varq, no artificial colour
Cut and set the same morning
Also in 250 g and 500 g gift boxes

products.name: Motichoor Laddoo — Desi Ghee

features: Fine boondi, soft bite, not dry
Pure desi ghee, slow-fried boondi
Standard 40 g or large 100 g laddoo
Bulk packs for puja and weddings

Rabri base reduced for 3 hours, no milk powder

Sealed 1 kg tin for gifting or travel

services.name: Home delivery in the city

offer.title: Diwali early-bird: 10% off gift boxes
offer.text: Book 20 or more Diwali gift boxes 7 days before the festival and get 10% off plus free logo stickers for your company.

reviews.name: Priyanka M., bride's mother
reviews.text: We ordered 300 shagun boxes of motichoor laddoo and kaju katli for my daughter's wedding. Every box was packed identically, delivered to the venue a day early as promised, and the laddoos were still soft on the third day. Relatives from Delhi asked where we got them.

reviews.name: Sandeep K., HR manager
reviews.text: Our office takes 120 Diwali boxes from them every year. They printed our logo on the sticker, kept to the budget we gave and sent a sample box first so we could check. The dry sweets travelled fine to our Pune team.

reviews.name: Rekha, regular customer
reviews.text: I buy their rasmalai every Sunday — the rabri is thick and not overly sweet. The besan laddoo tastes like my nani's, which I do not say about any shop. Only wish they opened earlier on Sunday.

faq.q: Do you take orders for weddings and large functions?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the items, quantity, packing style (per box or loose) and the delivery date on WhatsApp. We confirm the price and send a sample if you want. Orders above 25 kg need 3 days' notice and a 30% advance.

faq.q: How long do the sweets stay fresh?
faq.a: Milk sweets like rasmalai and rasgulla are best within 2 days refrigerated; khoya sweets like barfi and gulab jamun 4 to 5 days; dry sweets like kaju katli, anjeer roll and besan laddoo 7 to 10 days; namkeen 3 weeks in a sealed pouch. We write the best-before date on every box.

faq.q: Do you deliver at home?
faq.a: Yes, across the city for WhatsApp orders placed before 5 pm. Delivery is free above ₹999 within 5 km; otherwise ₹40 to ₹80 depending on distance. For outstation courier we send only dry sweets and namkeen.

faq.q: Can I get gift packing with my company's name?
faq.a: Yes. Rigid boxes, hampers and trays are packed here, and we can print a sticker or tag with your logo for orders of 20 boxes or more. Share the logo and we send a photo of the sample box for approval.

faq.q: Do you make sugar-free or vegan sweets?
faq.a: Sugar-free anjeer roll, dry-fruit laddoo and kaju katli (with a sugar substitute) are made on request with one day's notice; please check with your doctor if you are diabetic. Besan laddoo and dry-fruit laddoo can be made without milk solids for vegan guests.

faq.q: Can I order by weight or only in boxes?
faq.a: Both. At the counter everything is sold by weight from 100 g, packed in our standard box. For gifting we have 250 g, 500 g and 1 kg rigid boxes. Payment by cash, UPI or card at the shop; UPI for WhatsApp orders.

It takes the item list, quantity, date and address and hands the order to the owner on WhatsApp; it never promises a discount or a delivery slot the owner has not confirmed.

tailor.tagline: Stitched to your measurements, delivered on date
tailor.about: We are a family-run ladies and gents tailoring boutique in Main Market, stitching suits, blouses, lehengas, shirts, trousers and kurta-pyjama for the families of this city since the shop was a single sewing machine. Bring your own fabric or choose from the lining, lace and dress material on our shelves; measurements are taken in a separate ladies' cabin, and for bridal orders we come to your home. Every stitched garment gets a trial before the final finish and is handed over pressed, on the date written on your slip. Alterations on ready-made clothes are welcome, however small the job.

products.name: Ladies Salwar Suit Stitching
products.desc: Kameez, salwar or plazo and dupatta finishing from your own fabric, cut to your measurements. Straight, A-line, Anarkali-cut or Punjabi patiala in the same price.

features: Trouser or jeans length with original hem
Waist taken in or let out
Kurti and dress fitting on the body
Zip and hook replacement

services.name: Home measurement
services.desc: For brides, bulk family orders and elders who cannot come in, we visit at a fixed time within the city.

services.name: Fabric, lining & lace
services.desc: Cotton, rayon, georgette and lining by the metre, plus lace, buttons and dori on the shelf; bring your own fabric too.

services.name: Aari & embroidery work
services.desc: Neckline, sleeve and border embroidery, mirror and sequin work on blouses, suits and lehengas, matched to your photo.

services.desc: Frocks, kurtas, pathani suits and school uniforms in the right size, with growing room on the hem.

services.name: Urgent stitching
services.desc: A blouse or kurta in 24 to 48 hours when a function is near; a small rush charge applies, told upfront.

offer.title: Diwali & Wedding Season Offer
offer.text: Give a suit and a blouse together and the blouse is stitched at ₹400 instead of ₹550; brides who book a lehenga this month get the saree fall and pico for the whole family free.

reviews.name: Neha S., bride
reviews.text: My lehenga had 24 panels of heavy work and the first trial on the plain shell showed the waist needed to come in by an inch; they fixed it and the second trial fitted perfectly. The can-can gave the flare I wanted without the weight, and I could sit through the whole reception.

reviews.name: Rajesh, bank officer
reviews.text: I gave them fabric for four shirts and two trousers before a transfer. Collars are properly fused, the sleeve length was tried on me before finishing, and everything was ready on the Saturday written on the slip. Better fit than any ready-made I have bought.

reviews.name: Meena K., teacher
reviews.text: The blouse was stitched from a photo I sent on WhatsApp, with the boat neck and the back dori exactly like the picture. The padding is neat and does not show. Two kurtis I got altered the same day for a function that evening.

faq.q: How many days does stitching take?
faq.a: A blouse takes 4 to 6 days, a suit 7 to 10, a gown 10 to 12 and a bridal lehenga 20 to 25. In the wedding months and before Diwali the queue is longer, so the exact date is written on your slip when you place the order.

faq.q: Can you stitch a design from a photo?
faq.a: Yes. Send the photo on WhatsApp and we reply with the fabric length needed, what embroidery or lining it will take and the price, before you buy anything.

faq.q: How much fabric should I bring?
faq.a: Roughly 0.8 m for a blouse, 2.5 m kameez plus 2.5 m salwar for a suit, 1.6 m for a shirt, 1.2 m for a trouser and 6 to 7 m for a full-flare lehenga. Message us the design and your height and we confirm the metres.

faq.q: Is there a trial before delivery?
faq.a: Every stitched garment gets a trial before the final seam, usually two or three days before delivery. Lehengas and gowns get two trials. Small changes at the trial are free.

faq.q: Do you alter ready-made clothes bought elsewhere?
faq.a: Yes, jeans, trousers, kurtis, shirts, blazers and sarees. Bring the garment and the shoes or belt you will wear with it; length and hooks are done the same day if you come before 5 pm.

faq.q: How do I pay and is there an advance?
faq.a: Half the stitching charge as advance at the order, the rest at delivery, by cash or UPI. Fabric bought from the shop is paid for at the time of purchase.

teacher.jobTitle: Maths & Science Teacher | Home, Online & Small-Group Tuition, Class 6 – 12
teacher.about: We teach Maths and Science to students of Class 6 to 12 (CBSE and State Board) at the student's home, online on video call, and in small batches of six at our study room in Teachers Colony, along with a Spoken English course for college students and working adults. Every new student begins with a free trial class and a short diagnostic test, so we start from the chapter where the gaps actually are, not from where the school syllabus happens to be. Classes run on a fixed weekly timetable with a short test every Saturday, and parents get a WhatsApp report the same evening with the marks, the weak topics and what we will do about them. We are a postgraduate in Mathematics with a B.Ed. and twelve years of school and private teaching, and we take only as many students as we can personally attend to.

products.name: Home Tuition — Maths, Class 9 & 10
products.desc: One-to-one Maths at your home, three days a week, following the school's chapter order with NCERT, RD Sharma and previous-year board questions.
features: 3 classes a week, 60 minutes each, fixed days and time
Every chapter closed with a 20-mark test and a corrected answer sheet
Previous 5 years' board questions solved chapter-wise
Saturday test report to parents on WhatsApp

products.name: Home Tuition — Science, Class 9 & 10

features: 3 classes a week; Physics numericals get a dedicated day
Labelled diagrams practised for every Biology chapter
Chemistry equations and reasoning questions drilled before each school test
Practical file and project help included

products.name: Class 11 & 12 Maths — One-to-One

features: 4 classes a week, 75 minutes, home or online
NCERT fully solved, then board and JEE Main-level practice sets
Fortnightly full-syllabus-till-date test with marked answer sheet
Revision plan for the last 60 days before boards

products.name: Online One-to-One Class, Class 6 – 10

features: 3 classes a week, 60 minutes, on a fixed slot
Digital whiteboard notes sent as PDF after every class
Class recording available for 7 days for revision
Homework photographed and checked on WhatsApp

products.name: Small Group Batch, Class 6 – 8 (Maths + Science)

features: 5 days a week, 90 minutes (Maths 45 + Science 45)
Maximum 6 students, grouped by class
Weekly test every Saturday with ranks shared only with parents
Homework finished in class on two days a week

products.name: Spoken English & Confidence Course (3 months)

features: 36 classes over 3 months, alternate days, 60 minutes
Daily 2-minute voice note practice reviewed personally
Interview, phone-call and presentation practice in the last month
Separate ladies' morning batch available

products.name: Board Exam Crash Course, Class 10 & 12 (Jan – Feb)

features: 8 full sample papers written under exam conditions
Answer sheets corrected as per CBSE marking scheme with comments
Formula sheets and 'most repeated questions' booklet given
Last-week doubt sessions open till 9 pm on WhatsApp

features: Half-day (3 hrs) or full-day (6 hrs) formats
Handouts and practice sheets for every participant
Groups of 15 to 60, at your school or office
Feedback form and short summary report after the session

services.name: Free trial class and diagnostic test
services.desc: One full class plus a 30-minute test, so the first paid class already starts from the right chapter.

services.name: Saturday test and WhatsApp report
services.desc: A short test every Saturday; parents get marks, weak topics and next week's plan the same evening.

services.name: Doubt-clearing on WhatsApp
services.desc: Students send a photo of the question; a voice or written solution comes back within the evening, every school day.

services.name: Homework, project and practical-file help

services.name: Monthly parent meeting

offer.title: Diwali Enrolment Offer
offer.text: Join any home, online or batch course between 1 and 31 October and the first four classes are free; a second child from the same family gets 20% off the monthly fee for the whole session.

reviews.name: Meena K., mother of a Class 10 student
reviews.text: My daughter used to leave the Physics numericals blank in every school test. Sir gave the numericals their own day each week and made her write the formula and units before touching the calculator. The Saturday report on WhatsApp is the best part — I know every week which chapter is weak instead of finding out at the PTM.

reviews.name: Aryan S., Class 12 Commerce
reviews.text: I joined for Class 12 Maths online in July because there was no good teacher in my town. The whiteboard PDFs and the recordings saved me — I revised integration from the recordings three times before pre-boards. He also replies to doubt photos on WhatsApp even at 8 pm, which no school teacher ever did.

reviews.name: Priya R., bank employee
reviews.text: Joined the Spoken English morning batch for ladies because I would freeze when customers spoke in English at the branch. The daily two-minute voice notes felt silly at first but after six weeks I was speaking without translating in my head. Would have liked a few more mock-interview sessions, but the course is honest value for the fee.

faq.q: Which subjects and classes do you teach?
faq.a: Maths and Science for Class 6 to 10 (CBSE and State Board), Maths for Class 11 and 12 (Science and Commerce), and a Spoken English course for college students and adults. We do not teach Social Science, Hindi or languages other than English, but can suggest a trusted colleague for those.

faq.q: Do you come home, or do we come to you, or is it online?
faq.a: All three. Home tuition is available within about 5 km of Teachers Colony (Sector 5 to Sector 12 and the Station Road side). Small-group batches run at our study room in Teachers Colony. Online classes are open to any city; share your area and preferred timing on WhatsApp and we will tell you what is possible.

faq.q: Is there a trial class, and is it free?
faq.a: Yes. The first class plus a 30-minute diagnostic test is free, at home, online or at the study room. Only after that do we suggest a plan and fee, and you decide. There is no registration charge.

faq.q: What is the fee and how is it paid?
faq.a: Home tuition for Class 9 and 10 is ₹3,500 a month per subject, Class 11 and 12 Maths is ₹5,000 a month, online one-to-one is ₹2,800 a month and the Class 6 to 8 batch is ₹1,800 a month for both subjects. Fees are paid monthly by UPI or cash by the 5th, and a receipt is sent on WhatsApp. Taking two subjects or two siblings earns a discount; ask us.

faq.q: My child is weak and has lost confidence. Can you still help?
faq.a: This is actually most of our students. The diagnostic test tells us the real starting point, which is often two or three chapters, or even one class, behind. We go back to that point, build up with extra practice sheets and small wins, and keep the school syllabus moving in parallel. Progress is steady rather than instant, and we tell parents honestly each Saturday where things stand.

faq.q: What if we miss a class?
faq.a: If you inform us at least 3 hours before, the class is adjusted within the same week, usually on Sunday morning. Online students also get the recording. If the teacher has to cancel, the class is always made up and never charged. More than two uninformed absences in a month are not adjusted, so that the timetable stays fair for every student.

tiffin.tagline: Ghar ka khana, delivered hot every day
tiffin.about: We are a family-run tiffin service cooking from our own kitchen in Shanti Nagar for students, working people, bachelors and families who want proper ghar ka khana without the daily hassle. Every tiffin is cooked the same morning in filtered water and refined-free oil — phulka rotis rolled by hand, dal tempered just before packing, a sabzi that changes every single day so you never eat the same thing twice in a week. We pack in steel or food-grade containers, deliver on our own bikes within 5 km at the same time every day, and let you pause a day on WhatsApp whenever you travel or have a party. Try one meal first; most people who try stay for the month.

reviews.text: I have been on their monthly lunch plan for eight months. The sabzi really does change every day — I keep their weekly menu screenshot on my phone. When I went home for Diwali I paused for 9 days on WhatsApp and the days were added to the next month without any argument.

reviews.name: Mrs. Verma, mother of a hostel student
reviews.text: My son is in the engineering hostel and would not eat the mess food. We took the student mini tiffin for him and it comes to the hostel gate at 7:30 pm sharp. The rotis are soft even an hour later and they sent dalia when he had fever and I asked. Worth every rupee for a mother's peace of mind.

reviews.name: Dr. Nisha K., clinic owner
reviews.text: We take 12 office lunch boxes daily for our clinic staff. Boxes arrive sealed by 12:45 with the Jain ones clearly marked, and the Friday kheer has become a small office ritual. I would only ask for a little more variety in the rice days.

faq.q: Which areas do you deliver to, and at what time?
faq.a: We deliver on our own bikes within about 5 km of Shanti Nagar — covering the college road, the station side, the industrial area and the new sector flats. Lunch arrives between 11:30 and 13:30 and dinner between 19:00 and 21:00, at roughly the same time at your address every day. Send your location on WhatsApp and we confirm within an hour.

faq.q: What exactly comes in a tiffin, and does it change?
faq.a: The standard lunch has 4 phulkas, one sabzi, one dal, steamed rice, salad and pickle. Dinner is 3 phulkas, a dry sabzi, dal or kadhi and jeera rice on alternate days. The sabzi and dal run on a weekly cycle — for example rajma on Tuesday, kadhi-pakoda on Thursday, paneer on Saturday — and we share the week's menu every Sunday evening on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can I pause when I travel or skip a day?
faq.a: Yes. Message 'pause' with the date by 8 pm the night before and that meal is not cooked or charged. Monthly plans allow up to 8 pause days a month and the unused meals carry to your next month. A same-morning cancellation after 9:30 cannot be adjusted because the food is already cooked.

faq.q: Can I try before subscribing, and is there an advance?
faq.a: Order a single lunch or dinner at the daily rate (₹110 / ₹100) with no advance — pay by UPI when the tiffin arrives. New customers can also take the trial week of 6 lunches for ₹549. Monthly plans are paid in advance and the trial amount is adjusted if you continue.

faq.q: Do you make low-oil, Jain or doctor-advised meals?
faq.a: Yes. Our Diet and Recovery meal (₹120) is cooked with minimal oil and no red chilli, and we prepare Jain or no-onion-no-garlic food on request. Write your restrictions once on WhatsApp — things to avoid, salt level, rice or roti preference — and every tiffin follows them. We cook as per your instructions, not as a medical service, so please follow your doctor's advice on what to eat.

faq.q: What about the tiffin box — do I return it? How do I pay?
faq.a: Daily and monthly customers get a 3-tier steel tiffin; our rider collects yesterday's washed box when dropping today's, so please keep it ready. Office and Sunday orders come in sealed disposable boxes with nothing to return. Payment is by UPI — daily customers pay on delivery, monthly plans in advance, offices by weekly or monthly invoice.

faq.q: How is the rate decided?
faq.a: By distance, the vehicle size you need, the volume of goods and whether packing and labour are included. Send photos or a short video of the goods and both addresses on WhatsApp and you get a written quote within an hour; that quote is the final bill unless the goods turn out to be more than shown.

faq.q: Do I have to pack myself?
faq.a: No. For house and office shifting our crew brings the material and packs everything. If you want to pack yourself, book transport-only and we charge for the vehicle and loading labour alone.

faq.q: What if something breaks?
faq.a: Breakage on our packed moves is rare because of the way we wrap and load, but if it happens we settle it at the time of delivery. For intercity moves we recommend transit insurance at 3% of declared value, which covers accident, fire and theft during transit.

faq.q: Can I track where my goods are?
faq.a: Yes. At dispatch you get the driver's number and the vehicle number, the driver shares his live location at each halt, and the office sends a photo at unloading. For commercial loads we also send the LR and e-way bill copy.

faq.q: Do you take small loads to other cities?
faq.a: Yes, part load on our scheduled trucks to Delhi, Jaipur, Ahmedabad, Indore and Mumbai, three departures a week on each route, with a minimum billing of 50 kg. For other cities we check with partner transporters and tell you the rate and transit time.

faq.q: How and when do I pay?
faq.a: 20% advance on UPI or bank transfer confirms the booking and the vehicle. The balance is paid after unloading, by UPI, bank transfer or cash. GST invoice is given for every booking.

reviews.text: We were five people including my 68-year-old mother-in-law. The yatra manager arranged a palki at Kedarnath without us asking, hotels at Guptkashi and Badrinath had hot water, and every evening they told us the next day's plan. Not one day felt rushed.

reviews.name: Rohit & Neha, Kerala honeymoon
reviews.text: The same driver stayed with us for all six days and knew every viewpoint in Munnar. The houseboat night was the best part — the cook made fresh karimeen for dinner. Room was decorated with flowers when we reached Kochi, exactly as promised.

reviews.name: Mrs. Verma, school principal
reviews.text: Took 120 students of class 9 and 10 to Jaipur and Agra. The escort handled headcounts at every stop, water and veg meals were on the bus, and the parents got a WhatsApp update each evening. Billing was one clean invoice for the school.

faq.q: What exactly is included in the package price?
faq.a: Every package page lists it, and we send the same inclusions list on WhatsApp before you pay: hotel category, which meals, the vehicle, sightseeing entries and transfers. Flights and trains are extra unless the package says otherwise, and we quote them at the live fare on the day you confirm. GST of 5% is added to the package price.

faq.q: Can you make a custom package for my dates and budget?
faq.a: Yes — tell us the places, dates, number of people and a rough budget per person, and within a day you get a day-by-day plan with hotel options at two or three price levels. Most of our bookings are custom plans built this way, not fixed group departures.

faq.q: What happens if I need to cancel?
faq.a: Cancellation follows the rules of the airline, railway, hotel or operator, and we tell you those terms in writing before booking. For our own packages: 30 days or more before travel, the advance is refunded minus ₹1,000 per person; 15 – 29 days, 50% of the package; under 15 days, no refund. Date changes are free when the hotel allows.

faq.q: How much advance is needed and how do I pay?
faq.a: Tickets are paid in full at booking. For packages, 30% advance confirms the hotels and vehicle, and the balance is due 7 days before departure. UPI, bank transfer, card and cash at the office are all accepted, and you get a receipt and a GST invoice on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do you help with visa, and how long does it take?
faq.a: Yes — we fill the form, check your documents, arrange the photo and book the appointment where one is needed. Dubai takes 4 – 5 working days, Thailand and Singapore about a week, Schengen 3 – 5 weeks including the appointment wait. The decision is the embassy's, so we advise applying well before booking non-refundable flights.

faq.q: Is the Char Dham yatra suitable for senior citizens?
faq.a: Many of our yatris are over 60. We keep the schedule gentle with an acclimatisation night, arrange pony, palki or helicopter for the Kedarnath climb at extra cost, and carry oxygen and first-aid in the vehicle. A doctor's fitness note is advised for anyone with heart or BP issues, and medical registration is compulsory on the route.

We sell RO, UV and UF purifiers, under-sink systems, alkaline water ionizers, office coolers and commercial plants with the company bill and warranty, install them ourselves, and keep a technician on the road six days a week for service calls. reviews.name: Sunita D., homemaker
reviews.text: Our borewell water was 1,100 TDS and the old purifier kept failing. They tested it at home, suggested the Kent with a pre-filter instead of the costlier model, and fitted it the next morning. Tea tastes different now.

reviews.name: Manoj, restaurant owner
reviews.text: Took the 250 LPH plant for our kitchen and water cans. The site survey was honest about the softener we needed, and the plant has run every day for eight months. One WhatsApp message and the technician comes the same day.

reviews.name: Dr. Kavita R., physiotherapist
reviews.text: I booked the ionizer demo mostly out of curiosity. They showed the pH on a strip with our own tap water, explained what the machine does and does not do without any big promises, and the installation was clean. Very professional.

faq.q: Which purifier is right for my home, RO or UV?
faq.a: It depends on your water. Municipal supply below 300 TDS usually needs only UV + UF; borewell or tanker water above 300 TDS needs RO. We test your water free at home and suggest a model, and we will tell you if your existing purifier is enough.

faq.q: Do you give a demo of the alkaline ionizer before buying?
faq.a: Yes. Message us your area and a convenient time; we bring the machine, connect it to your tap and show the pH levels and taste on your own water. There is no charge and no pressure to buy on the same day.

faq.q: How often do RO filters need changing, and what does it cost?
faq.a: On typical city water, sediment and carbon filters every 6 to 12 months and the membrane every 2 to 3 years; on high-TDS borewell water, sooner. A full filter kit with service is ₹2,499; membrane is ₹1,800 to ₹2,800 extra. We note the date and remind you on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do you service purifiers bought elsewhere or other brands?
faq.a: Yes. We service Kent, Aquaguard, Livpure, Pureit, AO Smith and most assembled ROs. Send us the brand, model and the problem on WhatsApp; a visit charge of ₹300 is adjusted if you take the repair or an AMC.

faq.q: Is EMI available on purifiers and ionizers?
faq.a: Yes. Credit and debit card EMI on everything above ₹8,000, and zero-down finance through a finance company on ionizers and coolers. Bring Aadhaar, PAN and a bank statement; approval takes about 20 minutes at the showroom.

faq.q: Is alkaline or ionized water good for health?
faq.a: We can show you what the machine does to the water: pH, taste and the different modes for drinking, cooking and washing. For any health condition or medical question, please ask your doctor; we do not make health claims.

faq.q: How do I know the products are genuine?
faq.a: Everything comes from the company or its authorised distributor. Imported supplements carry the importer sticker and a scratch code you can verify on the brand's site; herbal products and devices come with batch, expiry and a GST bill. Check all of it at the counter before you pay.

faq.a: These are wellness products, not medicines, and we are not doctors. We can tell you what a product contains and how it is taken, but for any health condition, or if you are pregnant or on regular medication, please check with your doctor before starting anything.

faq.q: Do you deliver, and how fast?

faq.q: Can I return or exchange a product?

faq.q: Do you keep refills like glucometer strips and lancets?

faq.q: I run a gym or a shop — do you give bulk rates?
faq.a: Yes. Gyms, clinics and resellers get bulk pricing on monthly stock, and we do corporate and festival hampers from 10 boxes up. Send us your city and the products you need and we will share the current rate list.
